packages/coding-agent/src/cli/config-cli.en:
${} - Manage settings

${}
  list               List all settings with current values
  get <key>          Get a specific setting value
  set <key> <value>  Set a setting value
  reset <key>        Remove a setting from config.yml so its default applies
  path               Print the config directory path
  init-xdg           Initialize XDG Base Directory structure

${}
  --json             Output as JSON
  --scope <scope>    With list: only the keys the global or project layer sets, as written

${}
  ${} config list
  ${} config get theme
  ${} config set theme catppuccin-mocha
  ${} config set compaction.enabled false
  ${} config set defaultThinkingLevel medium
  ${} config reset steeringMode
  ${} config list --json
  ${} config list --scope global --json
  ${} config init-xdg

${}
  true, false, yes, no, on, off, 1, 0
packages/coding-agent/src/cli/config-cli.zh:
${} - 管理设置

${}
  list               列出所有设置及当前值
  get <key>          获取某项设置的值
  set <key> <value>  设置某项的值
  reset <key>        从 config.yml 移除某项，使其默认值生效
  path               打印配置目录路径
  init-xdg           初始化 XDG Base Directory 结构

${}
  --json             以 JSON 输出
  --scope <scope>    与 list 同用：只列出 global 或 project 层所设的键（按原样）

${}
  ${} config list
  ${} config get theme
  ${} config set theme catppuccin-mocha
  ${} config set compaction.enabled false
  ${} config set defaultThinkingLevel medium
  ${} config reset steeringMode

  true, false, yes, no, on, off, 1, 0

packages/coding-agent/src/cli/plugin-cli.en:
${} - Plugin lifecycle management

${}
  install <source>[features]     Install plugins from npm, GitHub, or git URL
  uninstall <pkg>                Remove plugins
  list                           Show installed plugins
  link <path>                    Link local plugin for development
  doctor                         Check plugin health
  features <pkg>                 View/modify enabled features
  config <cmd> <pkg> [key] [val] Manage plugin settings
  enable <pkg>                   Enable a disabled plugin
  disable <pkg>                  Disable plugin without uninstalling
  marketplace <cmd>            Manage marketplace sources (add, remove, update, list)
  discover [marketplace]        Browse available marketplace plugins

${}
  pkg                Install with default features
  pkg[feat1,feat2]   Install with specific features
  pkg[*]             Install with all features
  pkg[]              Install with no optional features

${}
  pkg, pkg@1.2.3                  npm package (optionally pinned)
  github:user/repo[#ref]          GitHub shorthand (also gitlab:, bitbucket:, codeberg:, sourcehut:)
  https://github.com/user/repo    Full git URL (https, ssh, or git protocol)
  name@marketplace                Marketplace plugin (see marketplace command)
  ./path, ../path, /abs, ~/path   Local plugin directory (symlinked, same as plugin link)

${}
  config list <pkg>              List all settings
  config get <pkg> <key>         Get a setting value
  config set <pkg> <key> <val>   Set a setting value
  config delete <pkg> <key>      Delete a setting
  config validate                Validate all plugin settings

${}
  --json           Output as JSON
  --fix            Attempt automatic fixes (doctor)
  --force          Overwrite without prompting (install)
  --scope <scope>  Install scope: user (default) or project (install name@marketplace)
  --dry-run        Preview changes without applying (install, uninstall, link, upgrade of marketplace plugins)
  -l, --local      Use project-local overrides

${}
  ${} plugin install @oh-my-pi/exa[search]
  ${} plugin list --json
  ${} plugin features my-plugin --enable search,web
  ${} plugin config set my-plugin apiKey sk-xxx
  ${} plugin doctor --fix
  ${} plugin install --scope project name@marketplace
  ${} plugin install github:user/repo#v1.0

packages/coding-agent/src/cli/skill-cli..en:
Usage: omp skill <action> [...]

Install and discover:
  install [@scope/name[@range]...] [-g] [--yes]   Install skills (no specs: install from skills.json)
  update [name...] [-g] [--yes]                   Update installed skills within their ranges
  uninstall <name...> [-g]                        Remove installed skills
  search <query> [--sort relevance|downloads|recent] [--json]
  info <@scope/name[@version]> [--json]
  list [dir] [--json]                             Skills a session in dir resolves, with warnings

Publish and manage:
  publish [dir] [--scope s] [--tag t] [--dry-run] [--allow-secrets]
  version <patch|minor|major|x.y.z> [dir]         Bump metadata.version in SKILL.md
  tag <@scope/name@version> <tag>                 Point a dist-tag at a version
  tag rm <@scope/name> <tag>                      Remove a dist-tag
  yank <@scope/name@version> [--undo]             Hide a version from range resolution
  deprecate <@scope/name[@range]> <message|--undo>
  owner add|rm <@scope/name> <username>
  token create <name> [--package @scope/name]... [--expires days]
  token ls [--json]
  token revoke <id>
  import <file.skill>                             Publish a Claude .skill archive

Management commands accept --registry <url> (default: skills.registryUrl).
packages/coding-agent/src/cli/skill-cli..zh:
用法：omp skill <action> [...]

安装与发现：
  install [@scope/name[@range]...] [-g] [--yes]   安装 skill（无参数：按 skills.json 安装）
  update [name...] [-g] [--yes]                   在其版本范围内更新已装 skill
  uninstall <name...> [-g]                        移除已装 skill
  search <query> [--sort relevance|downloads|recent] [--json]
  info <@scope/name[@version]> [--json]
  list [dir] [--json]                             列出 dir 中会话可解析的 skill（含警告）

发布与管理：
  publish [dir] [--scope s] [--tag t] [--dry-run] [--allow-secrets]
  version <patch|minor|major|x.y.z> [dir]         递增 SKILL.md 中的 metadata.version
  tag <@scope/name@version> <tag>                 将 dist-tag 指向某版本
  tag rm <@scope/name> <tag>                      移除 dist-tag
  yank <@scope/name@version> [--undo]             从范围解析中隐藏某版本
  deprecate <@scope/name[@range]> <message|--undo>
  owner add|rm <@scope/name> <username>
  token create <name> [--package @scope/name]... [--expires days]
  token ls [--json]
  token revoke <id>
  import <file.skill>                             发布 Claude .skill 归档

管理命令接受 --registry <url>（默认：skills.registryUrl）。

packages/coding-agent/src/cli/web-search.en:
${} - Test web search models

${}
  ${} q [options] <query>
  ${} web-search [options] <query>

${}
  query      Search query text

${}
  --model <selector>  Catalog model selector (for example, web/duckduckgo)
  --recency <value>   Recency filter (when supported): ${}
  -l, --limit <n>     Max results to return
  --compact           Render condensed output
  -h, --help          Show this help

${}
  site:/-site:  after:/before: (YYYY-MM-DD)  inurl:  intitle:  filetype:
  "exact phrase"  -term  OR
  Mapped to native provider filters where available, otherwise applied as a
  lenient post-filter (a constraint matching nothing is relaxed, not fatal).

${}
  ${} q --model=web/duckduckgo "what's the color of the sky"
  ${} q --model=openrouter/google/gemini-2.5-flash --recency=week "latest TypeScript changes"
  ${} q 'transformer scaling site:arxiv.org after:2024 -site:reddit.com'
packages/coding-agent/src/cli/web-search.zh:
${} - 测试网页搜索模型

${}
  ${} q [options] <query>
  ${} web-search [options] <query>

${}
  query      搜索查询文本

${}
  --model <selector>  Catalog 模型选择器（例如 web/duckduckgo）
  --recency <value>   时效过滤（支持时）：${}
  -l, --limit <n>     返回的最大结果数
  --compact           精简输出
  -h, --help          显示此帮助

${}
  site:/-site:  after:/before: (YYYY-MM-DD)  inurl:  intitle:  filetype:
  "exact phrase"  -term  OR
  可用时映射为服务商原生过滤，否则作为宽松后置过滤
  （匹配不到任何结果的约束会被放宽，而非报错）。

${}
  ${} q --model=web/duckduckgo "what's the color of the sky"
  ${} q --model=openrouter/google/gemini-2.5-flash --recency=week "latest TypeScript changes"
  ${} q 'transformer scaling site:arxiv.org after:2024 -site:reddit.com'

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 替换宿主方 URI scheme。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Forward only the listed session event types; null forwards all.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 仅转发列出的会话事件类型；null 转发全部。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: List running subagents.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 列出运行中的子代理。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Read a subagent transcript by id or registered session file (`subagentId` wins).
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 按 id 或已注册会话文件读取子代理记录（`subagentId` 优先）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Hard-kill one running subagent; false when it is not running.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 强杀一个运行中的子代理；未在运行时返回 false。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Send a message to a running subagent as its user.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 以用户身份向运行中的子代理发消息。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Start a live voice session bound to this session; returns the voice in use.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 启动绑定到本会话的实时语音会话；返回所用语音。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Start a live voice session whose audio runs on a caller-owned WebRTC peer: send its SDP offer, apply the returned answer.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 启动音频走调用方自有 WebRTC peer 的实时语音会话：发送其 SDP offer，应用返回的 answer。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Stop the live voice session, if any.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 停止实时语音会话（若有）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Set microphone mute, or toggle it when `muted` is omitted; returns the new state.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 设置麦克风静音，省略 `muted` 时切换；返回新状态。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Start draft-only speech-to-text; resolves once the microphone is recording.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 开始仅草稿的语音转文字；麦克风开始录音后返回。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Stop and flush draft-only dictation, returning the accumulated text.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 停止并冲刷仅草稿听写，返回累积文本。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Cycle to the next model.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 切换到下一个模型。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: List available models.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 列出可用模型。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Set the thinking level.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 设置思考级别。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Cycle to the next thinking level.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 切换到下一个思考级别。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Selectable thinking levels for the live model, `"off"` first.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 当前模型可选的思考级别，`"off"` 在前。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Set how queued steering is delivered.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 设置排队引导消息的投递方式。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Set how queued follow-ups are delivered.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 设置排队跟进消息的投递方式。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Set how steering interrupts tools.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 设置引导消息如何打断工具。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Compact the conversation.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 压缩会话。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Enable or disable auto-compaction.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 启用或禁用自动压缩。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Override cache warming for this session only; returns the effective mode.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 仅对本会话覆盖缓存预热；返回生效模式。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Enable or disable auto-retry.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 启用或禁用自动重试。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Abort a pending auto-retry.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 中止一次待执行的自动重试。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Run a shell command. Before excluding output, require ready.supportsBashExcludeFromContext to be true.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 运行 shell 命令。排除输出前要求 ready.supportsBashExcludeFromContext 为 true。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Abort the running shell command.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 中止运行中的 shell 命令。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Session statistics.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 会话统计。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Export the session as HTML; returns the written path.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 把会话导出为 HTML；返回写入的路径。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Branch the session at an entry.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 在某个条目处将会话分叉。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Fork into a new session file: history through `entryId`, or the whole session.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 分叉到新会话文件：含到 `entryId` 为止的历史，或整个会话。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Move the session's leaf to an entry in the same file, optionally summarizing the branch it leaves; refused while busy.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 把会话的叶子移到同文件中的某条目，可选地对其离开的分支做摘要；忙碌时被拒绝。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Summarize the abandoned branch at the target.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 在目标处对被放弃的分支做摘要。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Instructions for the summarizer.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 给摘要器的指令。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Stop a running `navigate_tree` branch summary; the navigation is cancelled.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 停止运行中的 `navigate_tree` 分支摘要；该导航被取消。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Set or clear (omit `label`) an entry's label.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 设置或清除（省略 `label`）某条目的标签。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: List user messages that can be branched from.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 列出可分叉的用户消息。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Text of the last assistant message, if any.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 最后一条助手消息的文本（若有）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Rename the session.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 重命名会话。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Hand the conversation off to a fresh session; null when no handoff was produced.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 把会话移交给一个新会话；未产生移交时返回 null。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Every message of the session in one response.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一次响应返回会话的全部消息。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: One stable page of messages.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一页稳定的消息。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: List OAuth providers and their authentication status.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 列出 OAuth 服务商及其认证状态。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Run OAuth login; the flow arrives as `open_url` and `input` UI requests.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 执行 OAuth 登录；流程以 `open_url` 与 `input` UI 请求形式到达。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: List the stored credentials `logout` can remove for a provider, active first.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 列出 `logout` 可为某服务商移除的已存凭据，当前使用中的在前。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Remove one stored credential; fails when it is no longer stored. `remainingSource` names auth that still applies.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 移除一个已存凭据；已不再存储时失败。`remainingSource` 指明仍生效的认证。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Ghost-text suffix for the prose word ending at `cursor` (a UTF-16 offset); null when none applies.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 对在 `cursor`（UTF-16 偏移）处结束的散文词给出幽灵文本后缀；无适用时返回 null。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Report a shown suggestion as accepted or typed past.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 上报一条已展示的建议被接受还是被越过。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Ask a side question, or a follow-up in topic `recordId`; returns the record once it is running.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 提一个旁支问题，或在话题 `recordId` 中追问；运行后返回该记录。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Cancel the running side question (only topic `recordId` when given); false when none matches.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 取消运行中的旁支问题（给定 `recordId` 时仅该话题）；无匹配时返回 false。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: List the session's side-question records, newest first.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 列出会话的旁支问题记录，最新的在前。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Model role the switch records (a quick-role pick passes its role); default `default`. Nothing is persisted.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 切换记录的模型角色（快捷角色选择传其角色）；默认 `default`。不持久化任何内容。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Model picker rows ordered and ranked as omp's session model picker shows them; a query starting with `@` lists quick roles.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 模型选择器行，按 omp 会话模型选择器的排序与排名显示；以 `@` 开头的查询列出快捷角色。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Search text; blank browses every model, `provider/` limits matches to a provider.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 搜索文本；空白浏览所有模型，`provider/` 限定到某服务商。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Continue the agent (the TUI's `.`/`c` shortcut), interrupting a running turn first; queued input continues the run in place of the continue directive. Acknowledged once the continuation is under way.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 继续代理（TUI 的 `.`/`c` 快捷键），先中断正在运行的轮次；排队输入取代 continue 指令继续本次运行。继续开始后被确认。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Thinking level to run the model at, clamped to it; omitted re-applies the session's level.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 运行模型的思考档，按其钳制；省略则重新应用会话的档位。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: `auto` lets omp pick the effort per turn.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `auto` 让 omp 每轮挑选 effort。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Most rows to return; default 100.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 最多返回的行数；默认 100。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Abort the current run and continue it with the queued user input (the TUI's empty Enter); `aborted` is false when no run was streaming with queued input.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 中止当前运行并用排队中的用户输入继续（TUI 的空回车）；没有带排队输入的运行在流式时 `aborted` 为 false。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Prose the model addressed to the user, returned by the provider as thinking; present it as answer text.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 模型发给用户的正文，由服务商以 thinking 返回；请按答复文本呈现。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Parent-agent IRC message carried by a steer; render it instead of the model-facing `content` envelope.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 由 steer 携带的父代理 IRC 消息；渲染它而非面向模型的 `content` 封装。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Who initiated a message, for billing and attribution.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 消息发起方，用于计费与归属。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Base64-encoded image bytes.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: Base64 编码的图片字节。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Inline image; also the shape hosts send with prompts.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 内联图片；也是宿主随提示词发送的形状。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Anthropic server-side fallback boundary marker; consumers other than Anthropic ignore it.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: Anthropic 服务端回退边界标记；非 Anthropic 消费方忽略。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Message content: plain text or content blocks.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 消息内容：纯文本或内容块。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Sending parent agent id.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 发送方父代理 id。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Message body as the parent wrote it.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 父代理所写的消息正文。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A transcript message, discriminated by `role`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一条会话记录消息，按 `role` 区分。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Streaming update for one assistant message, discriminated by `type`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一条助手消息的流式更新，按 `type` 区分。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Thinking selector; `inherit` defers to a higher-level selector.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 思考强度选择器；`inherit` 交由更上层选择器决定。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: User-configured thinking selector, including automatic selection.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 用户配置的思考强度选择器，含自动选择。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Per-million-token USD rates.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 每百万词元的美元单价。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Accepted input modalities, e.g. `text`, `image`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 接受的输入模态，如 `text`、`image`。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Null when the provider does not report a limit.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 服务商不上报上限时为 null。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Model descriptor: the client-relevant subset of the server's model record.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 模型描述符：服务器模型记录中与客户端相关的子集。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Messages of the run; an oversized frame drops a prefix already delivered by `message_end` (see `messageCount`).
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 本运行的消息；超大帧会丢弃已由 `message_end` 送达的前缀（见 `messageCount`）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Rule injection: a TTSR rule matched the stream and its text was injected. Each rule carries at least `name`, `path`, and `content`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 规则注入：一条 TTSR 规则命中流且其文本已注入。每条规则至少携带 `name`、`path` 与 `content`。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Leading `steering` entries are live steering already sent into the streaming response; `remove_queued_message` cannot reach them.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 前导 `steering` 条目是已送入流式响应的实时引导；`remove_queued_message` 无法触及它们。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Shared by the start, updates, and end of one message; unique per process.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 由一条消息的 start、update 与 end 共享；每个进程内唯一。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Calls of an unpaired assistant tail a continued run executes before its first model request.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 被延续的运行在其首个模型请求之前执行的、无配对的助手尾段调用。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Original message count when the frame was compacted.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 帧被压缩时的原始消息数。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: False when a continuation or async delivery remains.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 还有续传或异步投递时为 false。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The agent finished its turn and resumes only for queued input or background-job results.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 代理已结束本轮，仅在排队输入或后台任务结果到达时恢复。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Non-terminal end whose only possible resume is a background-job result.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 非终结性结束；唯一可能的恢复来自后台任务结果。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Compaction was skipped for a benign reason.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 压缩因无害原因被跳过。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The `/compact <mode>` subcommand, when one was given.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 给定的 `/compact <mode>` 子命令（如有）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Present when the compaction committed.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 压缩已提交时存在。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The compaction was cancelled (abort, or a `session_before_compact` hook).
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 压缩已取消（中止，或 `session_before_compact` hook）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: There was nothing to compact; `errorMessage` says why.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 无可压缩内容；`errorMessage` 说明原因。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Outcome of the compaction announced by the matching `manual_compaction_start`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 与对应 `manual_compaction_start` 配对的压缩结果。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Persisted retry errors whose presentation changed when the retry settled.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 重试落定后展示形式变化的已持久化重试错误。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A prompt-cache refresh was handed to the provider.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一次 prompt 缓存刷新已交给服务商。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Present only when the refresh was billed.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 仅当刷新计费时存在。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Why warming stopped; absent while it continues.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 预热停止的原因；继续期间缺省。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Outcome of the refresh announced by the matching `cache_warming_start`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 与对应 `cache_warming_start` 配对的刷新结果。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The user's selector when it differs from the effective level.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 用户选择器与生效级别不同时的用户选择器。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The level `auto` resolved to this turn, once classified.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 本轮 `auto` 解析出的级别（分类后）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The effective thinking level changed.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 生效的思考级别已变化。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Goal mode changed, by a host `goal` command or the agent's `goal` tool.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 目标模式已变化，由宿主 `goal` 命令或代理的 `goal` 工具触发。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Coalesced snapshot of the displayable steering/follow-up queue, sent whenever it changes.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 可展示的 steering/follow-up 队列的合并快照，变化时发送。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A session event, discriminated by `type`; `set_event_filter` selects which are sent.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一个会话事件，按 `type` 区分；`set_event_filter` 选择发送哪些。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A manual compaction began. Handoff mode leaves live turns running and applies between turns or when idle.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 手动压缩已开始。handoff 模式让进行中的轮次继续运行，在轮次之间或空闲时应用。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: `bash` accepts `excludeFromContext`; require exactly true before sending excluded commands.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `bash` 接受 `excludeFromContext`；发送排除命令前须恰为 true。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: First frame after startup; transport fields are absent on servers without protocol v2.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 启动后的第一帧；无协议 v2 的服务器上无传输字段。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Transient: resubmitting later may succeed (omp's own retries are exhausted).
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 暂时性：稍后重交可能成功（omp 自身重试已耗尽）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: `cost_cap`: the session reached `session.maxCost` (`--max-cost`) and omp did not send the next request.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `cost_cap`：会话达到 `session.maxCost`（`--max-cost`），omp 未发送下一请求。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Failure detail of a `prompt_result` with `status: "error"`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `status: "error"` 的 `prompt_result` 的失败详情。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Nothing will wake the session again; when false a `session_settled` follows once background work drains.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 不会再有东西唤醒会话；为 false 时后台工作排空后跟随一个 `session_settled`。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Terminal outcome of one accepted `prompt` / `abort_and_prompt`, keyed by request `id`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一个被接受的 `prompt` / `abort_and_prompt` 的最终结果，按请求 `id` 对应。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The session went quiet: the last run yielded and no background work can wake it.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 会话已安静：最后一轮已让渡且无后台工作可唤醒它。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Slash-command catalog, pushed at startup and whenever command metadata changes.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 斜杠命令目录，启动时及命令元数据变化时推送。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The subagent runs as a detached background job.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 子代理作为独立后台任务运行。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Raw `AgentProgress` record.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 原始 `AgentProgress` 记录。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A subagent started or ended; sent at subscription level "progress" or "events".
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 子代理开始或结束；在订阅级别 "progress" 或 "events" 下发送。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Aggregated subagent progress; sent at subscription level "progress" or "events".
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 聚合的子代理进度；在订阅级别 "progress" 或 "events" 下发送。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A subagent's own session event; sent only at subscription level "events".
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 子代理自身的会话事件；仅在订阅级别 "events" 下发送。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Microphone (`input`) and speaker (`output`) RMS in [0, 1], at most every 100 ms.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 麦克风（`input`）与扬声器（`output`）的 RMS，范围 [0,1]，至多每 100ms 一次。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Accumulated text of one realtime turn; replaces earlier frames with the same `role` and `turn`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一个实时轮次的累积文本；替换同 `role` 同 `turn` 的更早帧。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Sent exactly once when a live session ends; `error` carries the failure cause.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 实时会话结束时恰好发送一次；`error` 携带失败原因。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: State of one draft-only microphone capture.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一次仅草稿麦克风采集的状态。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Full accumulated draft preview; replaces the previous preview for this capture.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 完整的累积草稿预览；替换本次采集的上一条预览。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Exactly one terminal frame per capture; text is the accumulated result.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 每次采集恰好一个终结帧；text 为累积结果。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Text appended to the running side question's latest answer.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 追加到进行中的侧问最新答复的文本。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Full side-question record on every lifecycle change (started, complete, cancelled, error); the last one per id wins.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 每次生命周期变化（started、complete、cancelled、error）发送完整侧问记录；同 id 以最后一条为准。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Output of a builtin slash command.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 内置斜杠命令的输出。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A builtin slash command changed the session title.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 内置斜杠命令更改了会话标题。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A builtin slash command changed the model configuration.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 内置斜杠命令更改了模型配置。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: An event could not fit within the transport limits and was dropped.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一个事件超出传输上限被丢弃。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Presentation metadata aligned positionally with `options`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 与 `options` 按位置对齐的展示元数据。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Index into `options` of the recommended choice.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 推荐选项在 `options` 中的索引。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: One question of an `ask` request; hosts always offer free text besides `options`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `ask` 请求的一个问题；宿主在 `options` 之外总是提供自由文本。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Index into `options` to focus first.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 首先聚焦的 `options` 索引。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Marker style for the first `markableCount` options.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 前 `markableCount` 个选项的标记样式。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: For `checkbox`: indices into `options` currently checked. Authoritative; hosts render it per option.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `checkbox` 用：`options` 中当前勾选的索引。权威值；宿主按选项渲染。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Leading options that get a marker; trailing ones are actions. Defaults to all options when `selectionMarker` is set.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 带标记的前导选项；尾部为动作。设置 `selectionMarker` 时默认全部选项。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Every question of one extension `ui.askDialog` call; sent only after `set_ask_dialog` enables it.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一次扩展 `ui.askDialog` 调用的所有问题；仅在 `set_ask_dialog` 启用后发送。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Close the dialog opened by request `targetId`; a later answer to it is ignored.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 关闭请求 `targetId` 打开的对话框；之后的应答被忽略。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Short loopback redirect to `url`; the truncation-safe copy target.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 到 `url` 的短回环重定向；可安全复制的目标。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Extension UI request, discriminated by `method`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 扩展 UI 请求，按 `method` 区分。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Answer to one `ui.askDialog` question: exact option labels, plus optional free text.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 对一个 `ui.askDialog` 问题的应答：精确的选项标签，加可选自由文本。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Answers a `select`, `input`, or `editor` request.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 对 `select`、`input` 或 `editor` 请求的应答。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Answers a `confirm` request.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 对 `confirm` 请求的应答。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Answers an `ask` request: one `AskAnswer` per question, in question order.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 对 `ask` 请求的应答：每问一个 `AskAnswer`，按问题顺序。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Host reply to an extension UI request; variants share `type` and differ by their payload key.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 宿主对扩展 UI 请求的回复；各变体共享 `type`，按载荷键区分。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Tool output: content blocks plus optional details.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 工具输出：内容块加可选详情。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Streams partial output of a pending host tool call.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 流式传输一个待完成宿主工具调用的部分输出。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Completes a pending host tool call; `isError` surfaces the content as a tool error.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 完成一个待完成宿主工具调用；`isError` 把内容呈现为工具错误。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Present for write operations.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 写操作时存在。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Required for a successful read.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 成功读取所必需。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Completes a pending host URI request.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 完成一个待完成宿主 URI 请求。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Server request for host-owned tools and URI schemes, discriminated by `type`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 服务器对宿主自有工具与 URI scheme 的请求，按 `type` 区分。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Non-command frame the host sends, discriminated by `type`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 宿主发送的非命令帧，按 `type` 区分。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The command's `id`; absent for failures the server could not correlate.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 命令的 `id`；服务器无法关联的失败则缺省。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Command result on success; its shape is the command's `result`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 命令成功时的结果；其形状即该命令的 `result`。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Failure message when `success` is false.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `success` 为 false 时的失败消息。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Machine-readable failure reason, when one applies.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 机器可读的失败原因（如适用）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Response to a command, correlated by `id`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 对命令的响应，按 `id` 关联。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Dismisses a dialog; `timedOut` reports the host's own deadline (an `ask` dialog then takes its recommended answers, a `form` its defaults).
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 关闭一个对话框；`timedOut` 表示宿主自身超时（`ask` 对话框随后采用推荐答案，`form` 采用默认值）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Answers a `form` request with the submitted form data.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 用提交的表单数据应答 `form` 请求。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Submitted values by control `name`: a string, a number, or a string array.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 按控件 `name` 提交的取值：字符串、数字或字符串数组。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: `set_event_filter` projection: `delta` replaces the accumulated snapshots with the block a start/end event touches.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `set_event_filter` 投影：`delta` 把累积的快照替换为 start/end 事件触及的块。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Forwarded subagent frames: none, lifecycle and progress, or also raw session events.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 转发的子代理帧：无、生命周期与进度，或连同原始会话事件。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Leading `steering` entries are live steering already sent into the streaming response; `remove_queued_message` cannot reach them.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 前导 `steering` 条目是已送入流式响应的实时引导；`remove_queued_message` 无法触及它们。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Displayable queue-chip text for pending user-authored messages; accepted verbatim by `remove_queued_message`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 待处理用户消息的可展示队列标签文本；`remove_queued_message` 原样接受。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A tracked goal: its objective, lifecycle status, and resource accounting.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一个被跟踪的目标：其目的、生命周期状态与资源核算。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Session goal mode; `mode` is `"exiting"` while a completed goal unwinds.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 会话目标模式；已完成目标收尾时 `mode` 为 `"exiting"`。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Outcome of every `goal` op; both fields are null when the session has no goal.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 每个 `goal` 操作的结果；会话无目标时两个字段都为 null。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Where `/slow` lives: persisted config shared by every session, or this session's flex tier.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `/slow` 所在位置：所有会话共享的持久配置，或本会话的 flex 档。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Epoch seconds when the limit that was hit resets.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 已触限额的重置时间（epoch 秒）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Percent of the low-priority allowance still available, when reported.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 低优先级额度剩余百分比（如有上报）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Requests are served on the provider's low-priority (slow) lane.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 请求走服务商的低优先级（慢速）通道。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Epoch seconds when the limit that was hit resets, if reported.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 已触限额的重置时间（epoch 秒，如有上报）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Whether paid extra usage serves requests once the allowance is spent.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 额度用完后是否由付费额外用量继续服务请求。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Requests run on a short wrap-up allowance past the limit.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 请求在超限后的短收尾额度内运行。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Provider-neutral state of an account past its usage limit, discriminated by `stage`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 账号超限后与服务商无关的状态，按 `stage` 区分。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: `/slow` applies to the active model.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `/slow` 应用于当前模型。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: `/slow` is on for the active model; always `false` when `slowModeSupported` is `false`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 当前模型的 `/slow` 已开启；`slowModeSupported` 为 `false` 时恒为 `false`。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Where the active model's `/slow` lives; absent when unsupported.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 当前模型 `/slow` 所在位置；不支持时缺省。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Usage-limit stage of the active model's account; absent outside wrap-up and low priority.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 当前模型账号的用量超限阶段；除 wrap-up 与低优先级外缺省。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Idle with nothing queued or pending; same predicate as `session_settled`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 空闲且无排队、无待办；与 `session_settled` 同谓词。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: System prompt sections, for session dumps.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 系统提示词分节，用于会话导出。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Current goal mode; null when the session has no goal.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 当前目标模式；会话无目标时为 null。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Bytes dropped from the middle of `output`, which keeps the head and tail.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 从 `output` 中段丢弃的字节数（保留头尾）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Lines dropped from the middle of `output`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 从 `output` 中段丢弃的行数。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Bytes the per-line column cap cut from `output`, across all lines.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 每行列上限从 `output` 各行合计裁掉的字节数。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Lines of `output` the per-line column cap cut; the artifact holds them whole.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 被每行列上限裁切的 `output` 行数；产物中保留完整行。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: First and last lines the column cap cut, numbered as in the artifact; absent when the numbering cannot match it.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 列上限裁切的首尾行号（按产物编号）；编号无法对应时缺省。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The per-line column cap in UTF-8 bytes, set when it cut a line.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 每行列上限（UTF-8 字节数），发生裁切时给出。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The embedded shell's final `ShellTrace` of the run; only when the caller asked for one.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 内嵌 shell 本次运行的最终 `ShellTrace`；仅当调用方请求时提供。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: `open_session` outcome; `resumed` is false when a fresh session was started.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `open_session` 结果；新开会话时 `resumed` 为 false。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The removed message's images, so the client can restore them with its text.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 被移除消息的图片，便于客户端随文本一并恢复。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Only ever `true`: the images exceeded the transport limit and were omitted; the removal still happened.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 只会是 `true`：图片超出传输上限被省略；移除仍已发生。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Queued user content withdrawn from the queue, as the editor would restore it.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 从队列撤回的用户内容，形式同编辑器恢复时。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Only ever `true`: the full result exceeded the transport limit and every `images` was omitted.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 只会是 `true`：完整结果超出传输上限，所有 `images` 都被省略。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Only ever `true`: even the text-only result exceeded the limit, so only an oldest-first prefix is listed.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 只会是 `true`：连纯文本结果也超限，只列出最旧优先的前缀。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: User-authored queued input withdrawn before the abort, oldest first.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 中止前撤回的用户排队输入，最旧优先。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Only ever `true`: `abort_branch_summary` stopped the summary; nothing moved.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 只会是 `true`：`abort_branch_summary` 停掉了摘要；无任何移动。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The target was a user message: its text, for the editor; the leaf moved to its parent.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 目标是用户消息：其文本供编辑器使用；叶子节点移至其父节点。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Failed edits by the engine's `errorKind`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 按引擎 `errorKind` 分类的失败编辑。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 下一页的不透明游标；最后一页缺省。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: OMP-native session entries in append order.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 按追加顺序排列的 OMP 原生会话条目。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Raw session tree roots.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 原始会话树的根。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Raw `AgentProgress` record.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 原始 `AgentProgress` 记录。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Pass as the next `fromByte` to read incrementally.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 作为下一次 `fromByte` 传入以增量读取。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: `fromByte` exceeded the file size and reading restarted at zero.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `fromByte` 超出文件大小，读取已从零重新开始。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Incremental subagent transcript read.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 子代理会话记录的增量读取。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Side-question turn lifecycle; `interrupted` marks a turn whose process died while it ran.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 侧问轮次生命周期；`interrupted` 标记运行中进程死亡的轮次。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Images attached to the question.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 附加到问题的图片。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: One question and its answer within a side-question topic.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 侧问主题中的一个问题及其答复。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A side-question topic: its first turn's fields plus follow-ups; the latest turn is the last follow-up, else the record.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 一个侧问主题：首轮字段加后续追问；最新一轮为最后追问，否则为首轮记录。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A stored credential `logout` can remove; `active` marks credentials the session may be using.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `logout` 可移除的已存凭据；`active` 标记会话可能在用的凭据。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: `agentInvoked: false` means the prompt completed locally and no `prompt_result` follows.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `agentInvoked: false` 表示提示词在本地完成，不会有 `prompt_result`。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Background jobs, their deliveries, child agents or queued peer messages can still wake the session.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 后台任务及其投递、子代理或排队的对等消息仍可唤醒会话。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Matching rows before `limit`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: `limit` 之前匹配的行数。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Steps of the model's thinking slider, low to high: `auto`, `off`, then its efforts. Absent when it has no effort to pick.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 模型思考滑块的档位，从低到高：`auto`、`off`，然后是其 effort。没有可选 effort 时缺省。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: It left background jobs running in the fork, where later commands' `jobs`, `wait` and `%N` miss them.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 它在分叉里留下了后台 job，后续命令的 `jobs`、`wait` 与 `%N` 看不到它们。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: What the command set carried back into the session's shell; `false`: it stayed in the fork.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 该命令集带回了会话 shell 的内容；`false`：它留在分叉里。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The role's display tag.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 该角色的显示标签。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Set when the command overlapped another one on the session's persistent shell and ran in a fork of it.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 当该命令与会话持久 shell 上的另一命令重叠并在其分叉中运行时设置。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The session's context exceeds the model's window.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 会话上下文超出模型窗口。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: One row of omp's session model picker.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: omp 会话模型选择器的一行。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Visible roles the model holds, built-in order first.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 模型持有的可见角色，内置排序在前。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The quick role this row applies (`@` search); pass it to `set_model`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 此行应用的快捷角色（`@` 搜索）；传给 `set_model`。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Model rows: the session's level as this model would run it (the untouched slider). Quick-role rows: the role's explicit level, which `set_model` should carry.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 模型行：本会话的思考档，按此模型将运行的方式（未动的滑块）。快捷角色行：该角色显式设的档，`set_model` 应携带它。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: A role a model holds, as picker rows chip it.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 模型持有的角色，在选择器行中以 chip 显示。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Leading rows that are recently used or role-held (the picker's Recent block); 0 when there is no such split.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 最近使用或持有角色的前置行（选择器的“最近”块）；无此分段时为 0。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The session runs this row: its model, or under `@` its active quick role.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 会话运行此行：其模型，或 `@` 下的活动快捷角色。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Selectors the active model accepts, as omp's thinking selector lists them: `off`, `auto`, then its efforts.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 活动模型接受的选择器，按 omp 思考选择器所列：`off`、`auto`，然后是其 effort。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: Auto-selected: the role has no configured model.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 自动选中：该角色没有配置的模型。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.en: The user's thinking selector: `auto` while auto mode picks the effort, else `thinkingLevel`.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/rpc/wire.zh: 用户的思考选择器：auto 模式挑选 effort 时为 `auto`，否则为 `thinkingLevel`。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/runtime-.en: send did not invoke the agent

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Glyph set for icons and symbols (Unicode, Nerd Font, or ASCII)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 图标与符号的字形集（Unicode、Nerd Font 或 ASCII）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Requires a Nerd Font, or a Glyph Protocol terminal (icons ship in-band)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 需要 Nerd Font，或支持 Glyph Protocol 的终端（图标带内传输）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Use blue instead of green for diff additions
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: diff 新增行用蓝色而非绿色

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Visual layout of the input editor and status line
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 输入编辑器与状态栏的视觉布局

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show a live generation tok/s readout: on the working row next to the session title, or in the native composer bar right after the thinking level, where the last reading stays between turns. Estimated from streamed deltas and corrected by the provider's billed output count as each message completes.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 显示实时生成 tok/s 读数：在会话标题旁的工作行，或在原生 composer 栏的思考等级之后（最近一次读数在轮次间保留）。由流式增量估算，并在每条消息完成时用服务商的计费输出数校正。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Model, path, git, context, tokens, cost
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 模型、路径、git、上下文、词元、成本

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Maximum info with Nerd Font icons
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: Nerd Font 图标下信息最多

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: How the line between the left and right segments reflects context usage (box composer only)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 左右段之间的线如何反映上下文用量（仅 box composer）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Solid accent line, no context feedback
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 实心强调色线，无上下文反馈

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Used portion in accent color, remainder dimmed
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 已用部分为强调色，其余变暗

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Percentage plus ticks at the speculative and auto-compaction boundaries
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 百分比加推测与自动压缩边界处的刻度

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Annotated line with the context percentage and window embedded in the gauge
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 带刻度线，上下文百分比与窗口内嵌在刻度条中

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Use the session name color for the editor border and status line gap
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 编辑器边框与状态栏间隔使用会话名颜色

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Use the terminal's default background for the status line instead of the theme's `statusLineBg`. Powerline end caps are dropped because they need a contrasting fill to bridge into the surrounding terminal.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 状态栏使用终端默认背景而非主题的 `statusLineBg`。Powerline 端帽被去掉，因为它们需要对比填充来过渡到周围终端。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show the thinking level as a single icon on the model name instead of a separate ` · <level>` suffix; in Tern's composer, as the model chip's icon instead of a separate chip (click the icon to cycle it).
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 把思考等级显示为模型名上的单个图标，而非独立的 ` · <等级>` 后缀；在 Tern 的 composer 中作为模型 chip 的图标而非独立 chip（点图标可循环切换）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Display hook status messages below the status line
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在状态栏下方显示 hook 状态消息

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Render images inline in the terminal
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在终端中行内渲染图片

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Resize large images to 2000x2000 max for better model compatibility
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 把大图缩到最大 2000x2000 以提高模型兼容性

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Prevent images from being sent to LLM providers
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 阻止图片发送给 LLM 服务商

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Maximum width in terminal columns for inline images (default 100). Set to 0 for unlimited (bounded only by terminal width).
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 行内图片最大宽度（终端列数，默认 100）。设 0 为不限（仅受终端宽度约束）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Maximum height in terminal rows for inline images (default 20). Set to 0 to use only the viewport-based limit (60% of terminal height).
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 行内图片最大高度（终端行数，默认 20）。设 0 则只用视口上限（终端高度的 60%）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Maximum number of inline images kept as live terminal graphics (default 8). Older images fall back to a text placeholder via a full redraw once the limit is exceeded. Set to 0 to keep every image (no limit).
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 保留为活动终端图形的行内图片最大数量（默认 8）。超限后较旧图片在整帧重绘时回退为文本占位。设 0 保留全部（无上限）。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: How a settled terminal resize refreshes transcript rows retained in terminal scrollback
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 终端缩放稳定后如何刷新回滚区中保留的记录行

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Replay the transcript at the new width below retained history
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在保留历史下方以新宽度重放记录

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Erase all terminal scrollback, then replay one current-width transcript
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 清除全部终端回滚，再以当前宽度重放一份记录

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Repaint only the viewport and keep history wrapped at its old width
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 只重绘视口，历史按原宽度保持换行

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Emit OSC 9;4 indeterminate progress while the agent or context maintenance is running (always on in Tern)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 代理或上下文维护运行时发出 OSC 9;4 不确定进度（Tern 中始终开启）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Report whether the agent is working, waiting on you, done, or failed over OSC 7501, for terminal tab indicators and agent inboxes
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 通过 OSC 7501 报告代理在工作、等你、完成或失败，供终端标签指示与代理收件箱使用

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Render Markdown H1 headings at 2x scale using Kitty's OSC 66 text-sizing protocol. Only takes effect on Kitty terminals; ignored everywhere else. Off by default.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 用 Kitty 的 OSC 66 文本尺寸协议把 Markdown H1 标题渲染为 2 倍。仅在 Kitty 终端生效；其他终端忽略。默认关闭。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Color headings by level, bold and italic text, inline code, and table headers from the theme's ANSI palette. Off uses one heading color and plain bold/italic.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 用主题 ANSI 调色板为标题按级别着色、加粗斜体、行内代码与表头上色。关闭时标题单色、粗斜体无样式。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as ASCII diagrams
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 把 Mermaid 围栏代码块渲染为 ASCII 图

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Invite the agent to draw diagrams and charts as SVG, rendered inline as images on terminals that show graphics
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 允许代理把图和图表画成 SVG，在支持图形的终端上行内渲染为图片

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Draw a chart under numeric tables in the agent's answers, in your theme's colors, on terminals that show graphics
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在代理回答中的数值表格下方画图表，用你的主题色，在支持图形的终端上

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Smart when the judge role resolves to a native TypeSafe jev model, else Always
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: judge 角色解析为原生 TypeSafe jev 模型时用 Smart，否则 Always

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: The judge model refines each chart: kind, columns, row names and grouping, scales, which way is better, and its title
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: judge 模型细化每个图表：类型、列、行名与分组、刻度、哪边更好、标题

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Chart every table that reads as numeric, using the built-in best guess
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 对每个读作数值的表格画图，用内置的最佳猜测

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Invite the agent to react to your message with an emoji badge on its bubble
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 允许代理在你的消息气泡上用 emoji 徽章回应

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show the agent run state in the terminal title's separator — an animated spinner while working (a static ':' under WSL), '>' when it's your turn, '!' when the agent is waiting on you
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在终端标题分隔符处显示代理运行状态——工作中为动画旋转符（WSL 下静态 ':'），轮到你时 '>'，代理等你时 '!'

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Glyph set for the working-state spinner in the terminal title — braille sweep, filling moon, single-dot cycle, or ASCII-safe line
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 终端标题工作态旋转符的字形集——盲文扫过、月相填充、单点循环或 ASCII 安全线
月亮 ○◑● 先填满再清空

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: ASCII - \ | / for fonts without braille coverage
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: ASCII - \ | /，用于无盲文覆盖的字体

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Milliseconds between frames of every spinner, the terminal title included; 0 shows static glyphs. Unset follows Motion
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 所有旋转符（含终端标题）每帧间隔毫秒数；0 显示静态字形。未设跟随 Motion

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Ceiling on how often the TUI repaints, streaming text included. Keystroke echo keeps 30 fps, so the pane you type in stays responsive
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: TUI 重绘频率上限（含流式文本）。按键回显保持 30 fps，所以输入面板保持响应

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Wrap paths and URLs in OSC 8 hyperlinks for terminal-native click-to-open (auto: detect support; off: never; always: unconditional)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 把路径与 URL 包成 OSC 8 超链接，终端原生点击打开（auto：检测支持；off：从不；always：无条件）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show each pinned subagent's current (or most recent) tool call beneath its row
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在每个钉住的子代理行下方显示其当前（或最近）的工具调用

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Reveal assistant text and streamed tool input smoothly while chunks arrive (Tern types assistant text out itself)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 分块到达时平滑显现助手文本与流式工具输入（Tern 会自行打出助手文本）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Hide model-initiated tool calls and results from the transcript
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在记录中隐藏模型发起的工具调用与结果

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show per-turn token usage on assistant messages
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在助手消息上显示每轮词元用量

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show the total prompt-to-yield time (including tool calls) on assistant message usage rows
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在助手消息用量行显示总的从提示到让出时间（含工具调用）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show a divider after an assistant turn whose request lost (missed) the prompt cache
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在提示词缓存未命中的助手轮次后显示分隔线

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show bash commands as an interactive execution visualization instead of plain shell commands
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 把 bash 命令显示为可交互的执行可视化，而非纯 shell 命令

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Maximum note lines a collapsed advisor card shows below its header (0 keeps the full preview; expand with the tool-output toggle)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 折叠的 advisor 卡片在标题下最多显示的备注行数（0 保留完整预览；用工具输出开关展开）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Collapse pre-compaction history behind the summary divider on the live transcript; disable to keep the full transcript inline with dividers at each compaction point
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在实时记录中把压缩前的历史折叠到摘要分隔线之后；关闭则保留完整记录并在每个压缩点放分隔线

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show terminal cursor for IME support
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 为 IME 支持显示终端光标

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Move the prompt's bottom border to a separate row so macOS IME preedit cannot displace it
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 把提示框底边移到单独一行，避免 macOS IME 预编辑挤占它

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: How to process queued messages while agent is working
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 代理工作时如何处理排队消息

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: How to drain follow-up messages after a turn completes
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 一轮完成后如何排空后续消息

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: When steering messages interrupt tool execution
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 操纵消息何时中断工具执行

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: When you ask /btw for a steering prompt, it drafts one in <inject> tags, highlighted in the answer; Alt+I (app.btw.inject) sends it to the main session
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 向 /btw 要操纵提示词时，它会起草一段 <inject> 标签文本并在回答中高亮；Alt+I（app.btw.inject）发送到主会话

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: How the current Vim mode appears in the status line
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 当前 Vim 模式在状态栏的显示方式

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Full mode name — NORMAL, INSERT, VISUAL, V-LINE, REPLACE
Do not show the mode in the status line
What happens between /loop iterations before re-submitting the prompt
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: /loop 每次迭代之间、重新提交提示词之前做什么

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Compact the session context, then re-submit the prompt
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 压缩会话上下文，再重新提交提示词

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Start a new session, then re-submit the prompt
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 开始新会话，再重新提交提示词

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Max wait for a `/loop --while` / `--until` condition command before treating it as broken and stopping the loop. Set to 0 to wait indefinitely
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: `/loop --while` / `--until` 条件命令的最大等待，超时视为损坏并停止循环。设 0 为无限等待

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Submitting exactly `exit`, `quit`, or `q` (any case) before the first message quits instead of prompting the model
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 首条消息前提交恰为 `exit`、`quit` 或 `q`（不分大小写）时直接退出，而非发给模型

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Submitting exactly a command name without the leading `/` (e.g. `model`, `compact`) runs that slash command; once the session has messages, press Enter twice to confirm

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Default filter mode when opening the session tree

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 自动补全下拉的最大可见条目（3–20）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Mark misspelled prompt words with the active macOS dictionaries
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 用已启用的 macOS 词典标记提示词中的拼写错误

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Learns your vocabulary from prompt history
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 从提示词历史学习你的词汇

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Small on-device language model blended with N-gram (downloads weights on first use)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 设备端小语言模型，与 N-gram 混合（首次使用下载权重）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Apply confident macOS spelling corrections after completed words
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 对完成的单词应用高置信度的 macOS 拼写纠正

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Suggest emojis from `:name:` shortcodes and expand text emoticons like `:D` or `:-)`
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 从 `:name:` 短码建议 emoji，并展开 `:D` 或 `:-)` 之类文本表情

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Skip welcome screen and startup status messages
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 跳过欢迎屏与启动状态消息

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 每个 setup 版本只显示一次新增的引导步骤

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Check for omp updates on startup
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 启动时检查 omp 更新

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: omp update 与启动更新检查使用的更新频道

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 启动时在后台安装 omp 更新；下次启动运行新版本

Check on startup and notify when updates are available

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Check on startup and auto-install updates
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 启动时检查并自动安装更新

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Choose whether update notes start as a summary, full details, or stay hidden
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 选择更新说明显示为摘要、完整详情，或保持隐藏

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show release and change counts with a /changelog hint
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 显示发布与变更计数及 /changelog 提示

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show the recent release notes in full
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 完整显示近期发布说明

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Do not show release notes on startup
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 启动时不显示发布说明

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Notify when the agent finishes a turn
Notify when the agent stops with an error
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 代理因错误停止时通知

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Submit an ask form's current values (your preselected answers) after this many seconds (0 disables). Also bounds cfg:// approval prompts; an unanswered approval denies the write instead of auto-submitting
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 经过此秒数后提交 ask 表单的当前值（你预选的答案）（0 禁用）。同样约束 cfg:// 批准提示；未回答的批准会拒绝写入而非自动提交

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Notify when the ask tool is waiting for input
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: ask 工具等待输入时通知

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Generate a brief LLM recap of where things stand after the terminal has been idle
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 终端空闲后生成一段 LLM 简报说明当前进展

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Seconds to wait while idle before showing the recap
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 显示回顾前等待的空闲秒数

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Automatically resume the most recent session in the current directory. If its model cannot be restored and model fallback is disabled, interactive startup warns and starts a new session without the saved history
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 自动恢复当前目录中最近的会话。若无法恢复其模型且已禁用模型回退，交互式启动时会发出警告并启动一个不含已保存历史的新会话

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show git branch, status, and PR information in the TUI and watch repository metadata.
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在 TUI（终端界面）中显示 git 分支、状态和 PR 信息，并监视仓库元数据。

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Theme used when the terminal has a dark background
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 终端为深色背景时使用的主题

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Theme used when the terminal has a light background
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 终端为浅色背景时使用的主题

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Remove the 1-character horizontal padding from the left and right of the terminal output
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 移除终端输出左右两侧各 1 个字符的水平内边距

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Animation style for working/loading messages; off under reduced or no Motion
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 工作/加载消息的动画样式；动效为减弱或无时关闭

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Soft cosine wave sweeping across the text
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 柔和的余弦波扫过文字

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Knight Rider 1982 red light bouncing left-right
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 1982 年《霹雳游侠》的红灯左右往返

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: One switch over spinners, shimmer, and decorative blink/fade. Streaming text is unaffected (see Max Frames Per Second). A spinner interval you set still wins
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 统一控制加载指示器、微光动效和装饰性闪烁/淡入淡出。流式文本不受影响（见“最大帧率”）。你单独设置的加载指示器间隔仍然优先

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Every animation at its own setting (default)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 每个动画按各自设置运行（默认）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Spinners at 250 ms, no shimmer, no blink/fade
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 加载指示器 250 毫秒一帧，无微光，无闪烁/淡入淡出

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Static spinners and title, no shimmer, no blink/fade
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 静态加载指示器和标题，无微光，无闪烁/淡入淡出

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Pinned live-agent jump list above the editor (off hides it; collapsed shows a few rows with an expander; full lists all)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 编辑器上方的置顶活跃智能体跳转列表（关闭则隐藏；折叠则显示几行并带展开器；完整则列出全部）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show a few rows with an expander

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 始终列出所有活跃智能体
输入法安全的提示布局

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Re-submit the prompt as a follow-up message (current behavior)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 将提示重新作为追加消息提交（当前行为）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Capture mouse clicks in the main session so live subagent cards and HUD rows focus on click, with a hover highlight on the target, and clicks on extension-owned links reach their extension (the link-hint key picks them without the mouse). Native text selection becomes ${}+drag while on, and mouse capture stops wheel scrolling — the terminal reports wheel ticks to omp instead — so scroll with the terminal's keyboard scrollback keys, or turn this off
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 在主会话中捕获鼠标点击，使在线子代理卡片与 HUD 行可点击聚焦、目标有悬停高亮，扩展自有链接的点击到达其扩展（链接提示键不用鼠标也可选中）。开启时原生文本选择变为 ${}+拖拽，且鼠标捕获会停掉滚轮滚动——终端把滚轮刻度上报给 omp——所以请用终端的键盘回滚键滚动，或关闭此项

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Modal prompt editing. ${} leaves Insert mode; Normal mode has hjkl, 0, $, ^, w, b, e, gg, G, counts, x/D/C, dd/yy, p and u; operators take motions or text objects (diw, ca(, dap); v/V start a Visual selection that y copies and d deletes
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 模态提示词编辑。${} 离开 Insert 模式；Normal 模式有 hjkl、0、$、^、w、b、e、gg、G、计数、x/D/C、dd/yy、p 和 u；操作符接 motion 或文本对象（diw、ca(、dap）；v/V 开始 Visual 选择，y 复制，d 删除

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Ask for up to four distinct predictions instead of one, most likely first. The ghost text shows the first one your draft matches; after inserting one, press ${} again to pick another. The same single request returns a few more output tokens
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 最多请求四个不同的预测而非一个，按可能性排序。幽灵文本显示与你草稿匹配的第一个；插入后再按 ${} 可换另一个。同一次请求只多返回少量输出词元

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Celebrate unscheduled Codex weekly usage resets and newly banked saved resets with a top-third fireworks overlay that remains until ${}
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 为非计划的 Codex 周用量重置与新入账的已存重置燃放烟花：占顶部三分之一、持续到 ${} 的覆盖层

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: What pressing ${} twice with an empty editor does: open the transcript rewind selector, open the session tree, or nothing
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 编辑器为空时连按 ${} 两次的行为：打开记录回退选择器、打开会话树，或无操作

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: After a completed turn, ask the active model to predict your next message and show it as ghost text in the empty composer; ${} or ${} inserts it without sending. Extra usage: every completed turn sends one more billed request over the whole conversation (counted in /stats)
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 一轮完成后，让当前模型预测你的下一条消息，并在空 composer 中显示为幽灵文本；${} 或 ${} 插入但不发送。额外开销：每个完成的轮次对整个对话多发一次计费请求（计入 /stats）

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Enable hidden notices for standalone ${} keywords
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 为独立的 ${} 关键词启用隐藏提示

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Keep drafts cleared with ${} in local ${} history until exit; disabling affects future clears
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 用 ${} 清除的草稿保留在本地 ${} 历史直到退出；关闭只影响之后的清除

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Show predicted word completions as inline hints: ${} accepts with a space, ${} without
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 把预测的单词补全显示为行内提示：${} 接受并带空格，${} 不带

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.en: Notify when an interactive console (bash `pty`) is waiting on you
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/settings.zh: 交互控制台（bash `pty`）等待你时通知

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/startup-.en: A prepaint composer is already active
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/startup-.zh: 一个预绘制 composer 已激活

packages/coding-agent/src/modes/utils/ui.en: Queued message with image for after compaction
packages/coding-agent/src/modes/utils/ui.zh: 压缩后待发送的带图队列消息
压缩后待发送的队列消息

${} 处的 ovnfs 在欢迎消息前关闭

packages/coding-agent/src/ovnfs/daemon.t.zh: 无法运行 ${}（${}）；请将 ovnfs.path 设为 ovnfs 二进制
