packages/coding-agent/src/ovnfs/daemon.t.zh: ${} 使用 admin 协议 ${}；omp 需要 ${}：请更新 ovnfs

packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/appr.en: Plan title is required and must not be empty.
packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/appr.zh: 计划标题必填且不能为空。

packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/appr.en: Plan title must not contain path separators or '..'.
packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/appr.zh: 计划标题不能含路径分隔符或 '..'。

packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/appr.en: Plan file not found at ${}. Write the finalized plan to ${} before requesting approval.
packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/appr.zh: 在 ${} 未找到计划文件。请先将要获批的计划写入 ${}，再请求审批。

packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/appr.en: Plan title must contain at least one letter, number, underscore, or hyphen after sanitization.
packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/appr.zh: 计划标题在清理后须至少含一个字母、数字、下划线或连字符。

packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/sett.en: Enable plan mode for read-only exploration and planning before execution
packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/sett.zh: 启用计划模式，在执行前进行只读探索与规划

packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/sett.en: Automatically enter plan mode at the start of every new session
packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/sett.zh: 每个新会话开始时自动进入计划模式

packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/sett.en: Automatically save approved plans to disk when plan mode completes
packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/sett.zh: 计划模式结束时自动把已批准的计划存盘

packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/sett.en: Directory for autosaved plans. Supports ~, absolute, and cwd-relative paths. Empty uses <project>/.omp/plans/.
packages/coding-agent/src/plan-mode/sett.zh: 自动保存计划的目录。支持 ~、绝对路径与相对 cwd 路径。留空使用 <project>/.omp/plans/。

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/prelud.en: ratchet approvals need an interactive session; headless runs can only continue a flow whose approvals are current
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/prelud.zh: ratchet 批准需要交互式会话；headless 运行只能继续批准仍为最新的流程

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/prelud.en: Say what to change; nothing is recorded
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/prelud.zh: 说明要改什么；不做任何记录

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/prelud.en: plateau reached: categorize remaining train failures before another content round
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/prelud.zh: 已达平台期：下一轮内容前先给剩余训练失败分类

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/prelud.en: The material changed during review; approve again
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/prelud.zh: 评审期间材料已变化；请重新批准

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: reps must be a positive integer
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: reps 必须是正整数

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: reps cannot shrink after the baseline; rounds would stop being comparable
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: reps 在基线之后不能缩小；轮次将不再可比

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: The split is frozen once the baseline is gated; re-splitting would invalidate every round
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: 基线被 gate 后划分即冻结；重新划分会使每一轮失效

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: The plan needs goal, reps, and command before it can be approved (call plan())
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: 计划需要 goal、reps 和 command 才能批准（调用 plan()）

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: The plan needs a train/test split before it can be approved (call split())
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: 计划需要训练/测试划分才能批准（调用 split()）

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: The cases changed after the baseline was gated; the frozen split and baseline no longer cover them. Start a new flow with init() under a new name.
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: 基线被 gate 后 cases 发生了变化；冻结的划分与基线不再覆盖它们。用 init() 以新名字开始新流程。

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: Set a goal with plan() before reading the train view
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: 先用 plan() 设目标，再读取训练视图

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: init() needs at least one cases path
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: init() 至少需要一个 cases 路径

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: init() needs at least one harness path (runner and grader)
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: init() 至少需要一个 harness 路径（runner 与 grader）

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: init() needs at least one change path (the surface being tuned)
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: init() 至少需要一个 change 路径（被调优的对象）

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: goal.hold must not include the target metric
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: goal.hold 不得包含目标指标

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: stop.plateau must be an integer >= 2
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: stop.plateau 必须是 >= 2 的整数

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: stop.rounds must be a positive integer
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: stop.rounds 必须是正整数

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: test_fraction must be between 0 and 1
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: test_fraction 必须在 0 到 1 之间

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: split() needs at least 4 cases; score the whole set instead
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: split() 至少需要 4 个 cases；请改为给整组打分

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: (no rounds gated yet)
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: （尚无被门控的轮次）

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: (unpriced models; add plan(prices=…))
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: （未定价模型；请添加 plan(prices=…)）

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: Approvals are not current (${}). A stale approval means its files or plan changed after the user approved them; re-run approve() for each stage.
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: 批准已失效（${}）。过期批准意味着其文件或计划在用户批准后发生了变化；为每个阶段重跑 approve()。

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: No row carries the target metric "${}". Targets are grade-dict keys, "score" for a bool/number grade, "cost_usd", or a numeric row field.
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: 没有任何行带目标指标 "${}"。目标可以是 grade-dict 键、bool/number grade 的 "score"、"cost_usd"，或数值行字段。

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: No catalog price for ${}; add prices via plan(prices={model: {in, out}}) to report cost
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: ${} 无目录价格；通过 plan(prices={model: {in, out}}) 添加价格以报告成本

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: Train and test ${} means differ beyond noise; the split may be unrepresentative
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: 训练与测试的 ${} 均值差超出噪声；划分可能不具代表性

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: ${}/traces holds transcripts for test cases (${}). The runner must write traces for train cases only; delete them, fix the runner, and re-run.
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: ${}/traces 存有测试用例的记录（${}）。runner 只能为训练用例写 trace；删掉它们、修好 runner 并重跑。

packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.en: Invalid flow name ${}: use lowercase letters, digits, "-" or "_"
packages/coding-agent/src/ratchet/ratche.zh: 无效流程名 ${}：请用小写字母、数字、"-" 或 "_"

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 同时在交流电下阻止所有系统睡眠并声明用户活跃（macOS `caffeinate -i -d -s -u`）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Start on the active model, then switch to a fast/cheap model (default the 'smol' role) at the first edit/write after the plan nudge's todo list exists — the strong model plans, commits the todos, and starts the implementation before handing off. Overridable per session with --prewalk / --no-prewalk.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 先在活动模型上启动，计划提醒的 todo 列表存在后、首个 edit/write 处切换到快/便宜的模型（默认 'smol' 角色）——强模型做计划、提交 todo、开始实现后再交接。可用 --prewalk / --no-prewalk 逐会话覆盖。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Model or role (default '@default') that /prewalk restart returns to for planning.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: /prewalk restart 回到的模型或角色（默认 '@default'）用于规划。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Model or role (default '@smol') that prewalk hands off to at the first edit/write: /prewalk, /prewalk restart, Enable Prewalk, and --prewalk. Auto-prewalk uses its own target.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: prewalk 在首个 edit/write 处交接给的模型或角色（默认 '@smol'）：/prewalk、/prewalk restart、启用 Prewalk 与 --prewalk。自动 prewalk 用自己的目标。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Ask the native judge resolved through the 'judge' role whether each new top-level user task front-loads its hard reasoning. Needs a native judge; without one nothing is classified. Independent of Enable Prewalk.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 让通过 'judge' 角色解析的原生 judge 判断每个新的顶层用户任务是否前置其困难推理。需要原生 judge；没有则不分类。独立于启用 Prewalk。
永不为 prewalk 分类提示词

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Classify each task and report the decision without arming prewalk
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 分类每个任务并报告决定，但不武装 prewalk

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: For confidently front-loaded tasks, arm a handoff from the active model to the auto target; the next task starts back on the planning model
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 对确信前置的任务，武装一个从活动模型到自动目标的交接；下一个任务回到计划模型开始

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Model or role (default '@smol') auto-prewalk hands off to at the first edit/write.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 自动 prewalk 在首个 edit/write 处交接给的模型或角色（默认 '@smol'）。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Maximum concurrent LLM requests per provider id (for example "openai" or "anthropic"), shared across local OMP processes with this config root. Omitted providers are unlimited.

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: When an image is attached to a model without vision support, save it under local:// and inject a description from a vision-capable model instead of dropping it

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Omit code blocks from thinking summaries and replace them with an ellipsis
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 在思考摘要中省略代码块并以省略号替代

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Instruct upstream providers to completely omit thinking summaries from responses (where supported)
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 指示上游服务商完全不在响应中包含思考摘要（支持时）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Private scratchpad; not shown to user. Disables supported GPT, Claude, and Gemini reasoning
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 私有草稿区；不展示给用户。禁用支持的 GPT、Claude 与 Gemini 推理

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: At your own risk: providers have flagged this request shape as abuse, up to account-level enforcement
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 后果自负：服务商已把这种请求形态标记为滥用，可至账号级处罚

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Enable automatic stream loop detection for model reasoning and prose
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 为模型推理与散文启用自动流式循环检测

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Apply loop guard to assistant prose messages in addition to thinking logs
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 除思考日志外，对助手散文消息也应用循环守卫
循环守卫工具调用提醒

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: When a Gemini reasoning stream emits many consecutive planning headers without calling a tool, interrupt it and inject a reminder to issue a tool call (requires Loop Guard)
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: Gemini 推理流连续发出大量规划头部而不调用工具时，打断它并注入发出工具调用的提醒（需要循环守卫）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Detect consecutive identical tool calls across turns and inject a corrective steer
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 检测跨轮连续相同的工具调用并注入纠正操纵

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Consecutive identical tool calls required before the corrective steer is injected
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 注入纠正操纵前所需的连续相同工具调用次数

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Render full tool descriptors in the system prompt and strip top-level/nested descriptions from provider tool schemas so descriptor text is sent once. Auto enables this for Gemini models and disables it otherwise
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 在系统提示词中渲染完整工具描述符，并从服务商工具 schema 中剥去顶层/嵌套描述，使描述符文本只发送一次。Auto 为 Gemini 模型启用、其他禁用

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Inline descriptors for Gemini models; keep them in tool schemas otherwise
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: Gemini 模型行内描述符；其他保留在工具 schema 中

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Always inline descriptors in the system prompt
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 始终在系统提示词中行内描述符

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Keep descriptors in provider tool schemas only
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 描述符仅保留在服务商工具 schema 中

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Surface the active model identifier in the system prompt so the agent knows which model it is
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 在系统提示词中暴露活动模型标识符，让代理知道自己是哪个模型

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Render the workspace directory tree in the system prompt. WARNING: This can bust prompt caching across sessions when files are modified.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 在系统提示词中渲染工作区目录树。警告：文件被修改时可能破坏跨会话的提示词缓存。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Require the edit tool for file edits and forbid sed/perl/python edits
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 要求文件编辑用 edit 工具，禁止 sed/perl/python 编辑

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: List available skills in the system prompt; disable to save context and toggle per-session with /skillful
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 在系统提示词中列出可用 skill；关闭可省上下文，并用 /skillful 逐会话切换

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Communication style rendered into the system prompt's personality block
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 渲染进系统提示词人格块的沟通风格

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Terse, evidence-first engineer; dense, action-oriented replies
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 简洁、证据优先的工程师；高密度、行动导向的回复

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Warm, encouraging collaborator focused on momentum and morale
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 温暖、鼓励型的协作者，关注推进与士气

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Direct, efficient engineer focused on clarity and rigor
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 直接、高效的工程师，关注清晰与严谨

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 1 = creative, -1 = provider default)
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 采样温度（0 = 确定性，1 = 创造性，-1 = 服务商默认）
核采样截断（0–1，-1 = 服务商默认）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Sample from top-K tokens (-1 = provider default)
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 从 top-K 词元中采样（-1 = 服务商默认）
最小概率阈值（0–1，-1 = 服务商默认）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Penalty for introducing already-present tokens (-1 = provider default)
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 对引入已存在词元的惩罚（-1 = 服务商默认）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Penalty for repeated tokens (-1 = provider default)
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 对重复词元的惩罚（-1 = 服务商默认）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: OpenAI Responses and Codex response verbosity (low, medium, or high)
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: OpenAI Responses 与 Codex 的响应详略（low、medium 或 high）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Every provider error may switch models
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 每个服务商错误都可切换模型

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Switch only on a usage limit; retry other errors on the same model, then surface them
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 仅用量限额时切换；其他错误在同一模型上重试后再上报

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Wait out or surface a usage limit; switch on other errors
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 用量限额等待或上报；其他错误时切换

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: On a rate limit, do not hold the retry.fallbackChains walk for a turn whose thinking is signed by the failing model. Off (the default), such a turn keeps retrying the rate-limited model until retry.maxRetries is spent before the chain is reached.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 限流时，对思考由失败模型签名的轮次不保留 retry.fallbackChains 走链。关闭（默认）时，这样的轮次会一直重试被限流的模型直到 retry.maxRetries 用尽才走链。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Use reliable coding-plan quota reports to prefer same-provider accounts, then configured fallback models, before a hard usage limit. Ordinary configured API keys are excluded.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 用可靠的编程计划配额报告，在硬用量限额前优先选同服务商账号，再选已配置的回退模型。普通已配置 API key 不参与。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Treat a coding-plan model as near its limit below this remaining percentage. Unknown or unmapped usage keeps the primary model.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 剩余百分比低于此值时，把编程计划模型视为接近限额。未知或未映射的用量保持主模型。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: What to do when every same-provider coding-plan account is inside the reserve margin.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 所有同服务商编程计划账号都进入预留余量时的行为。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Keep interactive sessions on the primary until confirmed; background agents auto-fallback
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 交互会话保持主模型直到确认；后台代理自动回退

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Always select the next eligible configured fallback
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 总是选择下一个符合条件的已配置回退

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Do not spend reserve quota or select a fallback
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 不消费预留配额，也不选择回退

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: JSON object mapping model roles, model selectors ("provider/model-id"), or provider wildcards ("provider/*") to ordered fallback selectors, e.g. {"default":["openai/gpt-4o-mini"],"google-antigravity/*":["google/*","google-vertex/*"]}. Model-oriented keys apply whenever that model/provider is active, regardless of role; a "provider/*" entry keeps the failing model's id and swaps the provider. An id-prefixed wildcard ("openrouter/google/*") re-prefixes the failing model's bare id (google-antigravity/gemini-x -> openrouter/google/gemini-x) and, used as a key, matches only that provider's ids under the prefix. A fallback entry may carry an explicit thinking suffix ("provider/model:low", ":high", ":max", ":off"); a bare entry inherits the failing turn's effort, and "provider/*" entries always inherit.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: JSON 对象，把模型角色、模型选择器（"provider/model-id"）或服务商通配（"provider/*"）映射到有序回退选择器，例如 {"default":["openai/gpt-4o-mini"],"google-antigravity/*":["google/*","google-vertex/*"]}。面向模型的键在该模型/服务商活动时生效，无论角色如何；"provider/*" 条目保留失败模型的 id 并只换服务商。带 id 前缀的通配（"openrouter/google/*"）给失败模型的裸 id 加前缀（google-antigravity/gemini-x -> openrouter/google/gemini-x），用作键时只匹配该前缀下该服务商的 id。回退条目可带显式思考后缀（"provider/model:low"、":high"、":max"、":off"）；裸条目继承失败轮次的 effort，"provider/*" 条目总是继承。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: When to return to the primary model after a fallback
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 回退后何时回到主模型

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Return to the primary model after its suppression window ends
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 抑制窗口结束后回到主模型

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Stay on the fallback model until manually changed
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 留在回退模型直到手动更改

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: When a Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 request is blocked by Anthropic's safety classifier, retry it on Claude Opus 5 server-side (Anthropic `server-side-fallback-2026-06-01` beta). Opt-in — leaving this off preserves the pre-fallback behavior for every request.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 请求被 Anthropic 安全分类器阻止时，在服务端用 Claude Opus 5 重试（Anthropic `server-side-fallback-2026-06-01` beta）。可选——关闭则每个请求保持回退前的行为。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Maximum concurrent Ollama Cloud subagent runs per process; 0 disables the provider-specific limit
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 每进程 Ollama Cloud 子代理最大并发运行数；0 禁用此服务商专属限制

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Endpoint routing strategy for google-antigravity providers (chat, search, image, discovery)
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: google-antigravity 服务商的端点路由策略（chat、search、image、discovery）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Try production endpoint, fail over to sandbox on 5xx/429
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 先试生产端点，5xx/429 时故障转移到沙箱

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Serving path for Fireworks requests. Priority sends `service_tier: "priority"` for higher reliability during peak traffic at a higher price; Standard omits it. Fast (`-fast`) models ignore this — Fast is its own serving path.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: Fireworks 请求的服务路径。Priority 发送 `service_tier: "priority"`，高峰时更可靠但价格更高；Standard 不发送。Fast（`-fast`）模型忽略此项——Fast 是自己的服务路径。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Priority serving path: higher reliability, premium per-token pricing
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 优先服务路径：更可靠，词元溢价

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Inference backend for local tiny models (titles + memory): an ONNX execution provider, or `mlx` to download MLX weights and run them through mlx-lm on Apple silicon. Default uses CPU-only ONNX. The PI_TINY_DEVICE env var overrides this.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 本地 tiny 模型的推理后端（标题+记忆）：ONNX 执行服务商，或 `mlx` 下载 MLX 权重并在 Apple silicon 上通过 mlx-lm 运行。默认只用 CPU ONNX。PI_TINY_DEVICE 环境变量覆盖此项。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: ONNX quantization/precision for local tiny models. Default uses each model's shipped dtype (q4); lower precision is faster, higher is more faithful. Ignored by the MLX backend (its repos are pre-quantized 4-bit). The PI_TINY_DTYPE env var overrides this.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 本地 tiny 模型的 ONNX 量化/精度。默认用每个模型自带的 dtype（q4）；更低更快，更高更准。MLX 后端忽略此项（其仓库已预量化 4-bit）。PI_TINY_DTYPE 环境变量覆盖此项。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Highest effort the `auto` classifier may resolve. `xhigh` keeps the classifier one tier below the top, so only an explicit `ultrathink` reaches `max`; `max` lets a turn the classifier judges exceptional bill the top tier on models that expose it.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: `auto` 分类器可解析的最高 effort。`xhigh` 让分类器停在顶下一级，只有显式 `ultrathink` 才到 `max`；`max` 允许分类器判定为特别的轮次在暴露顶级的模型上按顶级计费。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Classifier may resolve max where the model supports it
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 模型支持时分类器可解析为 max

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Automatically recover when the assistant stops without a visible message. Smart also classifies text-only stops with a small model.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 助手无可见消息就停止时自动恢复。Smart 还会用小模型分类纯文本停止。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Retry stops with no visible assistant message; tool calls are excluded (default)
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 重试无可见助手消息的停止；工具调用除外（默认）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Mechanical + small-model classification of text-only stops
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 机械 + 小模型分类纯文本停止

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: API format for Kimi Code provider (auto follows live model metadata)
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: Kimi Code 服务商的 API 格式（auto 跟随实时模型元数据）
使用模型服务端声明的协议

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: WebSocket policy for OpenAI Codex models only
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 仅 OpenAI Codex 模型的 WebSocket 策略
使用 Codex 模型默认

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Disable WebSockets for OpenAI Codex models
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 为 OpenAI Codex 模型禁用 WebSocket

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Force websockets for OpenAI Codex models
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 为 OpenAI Codex 模型强制 WebSocket

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Opt in for catalog-supported standard Responses models; model or request false disables it
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 为目录支持的标准 Responses 模型启用；模型或请求为 false 时禁用

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Deliver messages typed while a GPT-6 response streams into that response over the Codex WebSocket, instead of waiting for the next tool boundary
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: GPT-6 响应流式输出期间输入的消息，经 Codex WebSocket 直接送达该响应，而非等到下一个工具边界

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Store Muse Code results on Meta's servers so a turn whose connection drops is recovered instead of re-run. Stored runs keep prompts and outputs on Meta's side.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 把 Muse Code 结果存在 Meta 服务器上，连接断开的轮次可恢复而非重跑。存储的运行会把提示词与输出留在 Meta 一侧。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Automatically request the Daybreak Blue cyber access program on ChatGPT accounts eligible for it. OpenAI may use content from Daybreak Blue sessions to improve its models. Does not cover dedicated Daybreak Blue models (gpt-daybreak-blue-*), which may still run as Daybreak sessions.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 自动为有资格的 ChatGPT 账号请求 Daybreak Blue cyber 访问计划。OpenAI 可能用 Daybreak Blue 会话内容改进模型。不覆盖专属 Daybreak Blue 模型（gpt-daybreak-blue-*），它们仍可能作为 Daybreak 会话运行。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Provider default — Anthropic OAuth subscriber sessions default to 1h, API keys use 5m; PI_CACHE_RETENTION still applies
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 服务商默认——Anthropic OAuth 订阅会话默认 1h，API key 用 5m；PI_CACHE_RETENTION 仍生效

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Cheapest cache writes; pair with cache warming to keep short entries alive while idle
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 最便宜的缓存写入；配合缓存预热让短条目在空闲时保活

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Longer TTL where supported (Anthropic/Bedrock 1h, OpenAI GPT-5.6+ Responses 12h); pricier writes, only warmed during active runs
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 支持处更长 TTL（Anthropic/Bedrock 1h，OpenAI GPT-5.6+ Responses 12h）；写入更贵，仅在活跃运行中预热

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Disable prompt caching and cache-affinity routing
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 禁用提示词缓存与缓存亲和路由

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Protect expensive prefixes during long tool executions; stops when the agent settles
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 在长工具执行期间保护昂贵前缀；代理稳定后停止

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Also refresh 5-minute entries between runs while the expected savings stay above the cost floor
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 预期节省高于成本底线时，也在运行之间刷新 5 分钟条目

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Seconds to wait for the first model stream event; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 等待首个模型流事件的秒数；-1 用服务商/环境默认，0 禁用看门狗

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Use provider defaults and PI_* timeout env vars
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 使用服务商默认与 PI_* 超时环境变量

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Seconds a model stream may stay silent between events; -1 uses provider/env defaults, 0 disables the watchdog
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 模型流在事件之间可静默的秒数；-1 用服务商/环境默认，0 禁用看门狗

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Spend saved Codex resets on 5-hour-only blocks and on expiring credits whose fullest chat window is 5h.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 为仅限 5 小时的封锁和最快聊天窗口为 5h 的到期积分花费已存的 Codex 重置。
Codex 自动兑换已存重置（周）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Spend saved Codex resets on weekly blocks and on expiring credits whose fullest chat window is weekly. A block known only from a short 429 wait needs both Codex windows.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 为周级封锁和最快聊天窗口为周的到期积分花费已存的 Codex 重置。仅由短 429 等待得知的封锁需要 Codex 两个窗口。
Codex 自动兑换最小封锁

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Only auto-redeem when the natural unblock — the latest reset among the exhausted 5h/weekly windows — is at least this many minutes away (don't spend a scarce credit to save a short wait). Raise it (e.g. 360) to ignore 5h-only blocks.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 仅当自然解除——耗尽的 5h/周窗口中最晚的重置——至少在这么多分钟后才自动兑换（别为省短等待花掉稀缺积分）。调大它（如 360）可忽略仅限 5 小时的封锁。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Never auto-spend below this many saved resets (0 = the last credit may be spent automatically). Credits about to expire are exempt — a reserved credit that expires preserves nothing.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 已存重置少于此数时绝不自动花费（0 = 最后一个积分可自动花掉）。即将过期的积分例外——过期的预留积分什么都保不住。

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: With auto-redeem enabled, spend a saved Codex reset within this many hours of expiry when either chat window has meaningful usage. 0 disables early salvage; credits expiring within 5 minutes are still attempted regardless of usage.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 启用自动兑换时，任一聊天窗口有可观察用量时，在到期前这么多小时内花掉一个已存 Codex 重置。0 禁用提前挽救；5 分钟内过期的积分无论用量如何仍会尝试。
Claude 自动兑换已存重置（5h）

packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.en: Spend Claude Cedar or Juniper resets on 5-hour-only blocks and on expiring grants whose fullest covered limit is 5h.
packages/coding-agent/src/session/settin.zh: 为仅限 5 小时的封锁和覆盖上限为 5h 的到期授权花费 Claude Cedar 或 Juniper 重置。
Claude 自动兑换已存重置（周）

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 每次 Spawn 最大 Effort

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: New worktrees from `github pr_checkout` and `git worktree add` in bash start as a copy-on-write clone of the current checkout so ignored build artifacts (node_modules, target) carry over; falls back to a plain checkout when the filesystem cannot clone
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 由 `github pr_checkout` 与 bash 中 `git worktree add` 新建的 worktree 以当前工作副本的写时复制克隆起步，被忽略的构建产物（node_modules、target）随之带过来；文件系统无法克隆时回退为普通检出

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: When creating a worktree with `/wt`, reset tracked changes and remove untracked files from the original checkout after carrying them over
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 用 `/wt` 创建 worktree 时，迁移后重置原副本中的已跟踪改动并删除未跟踪文件

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Base directory for agent-managed worktrees — task-isolation copies, `github` PR checkouts, and `omp worktree` cleanup all live here. Unset uses ~/.omp/wt. Must be an absolute or ~-relative path; relative paths are ignored. The OMP_WORKTREE_DIR env var overrides this.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 智能体管理的 worktree 的根目录——任务隔离副本、`github` PR 检出与 `omp worktree` 清理都在这里。未设置时用 ~/.omp/wt。必须是绝对路径或 ~ 相对路径；普通相对路径被忽略。OMP_WORKTREE_DIR 环境变量覆盖此项。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Ask the native judge resolved through the 'judge' role which parts of each new top-level prompt can run concurrently. Needs a native judge and the task tool; without them nothing is judged.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 询问经 'judge' 角色解析的原生判定器：每条新顶层提示词的哪些部分可并发执行。需要原生判定器与 task 工具；缺一则不做判定。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Switch the task tool to its batch shape: one call carries { context, tasks[] } — one subagent per item, with an optional per-item agent (defaulting to the session spawn-policy agent), per-item isolation, and a required shared context prepended to every assignment. With async.enabled=true, each spawn runs as an independent background agent with the normal idle/parked lifecycle; otherwise the call blocks for merged results. Disable to restore the flat single-spawn schema.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 把 task 工具切为批量形态：一次调用携带 { context, tasks[] }——每项一个子代理，每项可选独立代理（默认会话派发策略代理）、每项独立隔离，以及必带的共享上下文加到每个任务前。async.enabled=true 时每次派发作为独立后台代理走常规 idle/parked 生命周期；否则调用阻塞等待合并结果。关闭即恢复平铺单派发 schema。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Spawns take ordered `steps` instead of one `task`: the subagent gets the first step, then each next one once it finishes the previous; past 4 steps, earlier messages carry two or more. The last step's result is the task's result.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 派发使用有序的 `steps` 而非单个 `task`：子代理先做第一步，完成后再做下一步；超过 4 步时，较早的消息会合并携带多步。最后一步的结果即任务结果。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Start each batch subagent as soon as its tasks[] item finishes streaming instead of waiting for the whole task call. Launched agents are aborted if the finished call fails validation, is blocked, or its arguments change. Requires auto-allowed task approval and no extension tool lifecycle handlers.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 每个批量子代理在其 tasks[] 项流式完成时即启动，而非等整个 task 调用结束。若完成的调用校验失败、被阻止或参数变化，已启动的代理被中止。要求 task 审批为自动允许且无扩展工具生命周期处理器。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Whether a subagent call may pick its model with one exact provider/model-id[@upstream][:level] selector. An @upstream pin is part of the model identity and is supported only by aggregators. Only models the configuration already routes to are accepted. Project settings can turn it off but not on, and never approve a model.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 子代理调用可否用一个精确的 provider/model-id[@upstream][:level] 选择器挑选模型。@upstream 绑定属于模型身份的一部分，仅聚合商支持。只接受配置已路由到的模型。项目设置只能关不能开，也绝不会批准某个模型。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Exact selectors: `provider/model-id`, including `@upstream` only for a pinned OpenRouter/Vercel route (e.g. `openrouter/x@y`). When set, a per-call model must also be listed here. Empty: every model the configuration grants. A project list can only narrow this one.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 精确选择器：`provider/model-id`，仅固定 OpenRouter/Vercel 路由时可带 `@upstream`（如 `openrouter/x@y`）。设置后，按调用模型也必须列在其中。为空：配置放行的所有模型。项目级列表只能收窄此名单。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Maximum worker threads for subagents. Up to 8 concurrent subagents run on the main thread; at 9 one worker joins, and one more each time the count doubles (18, 36, 72). Workers stop a minute after no subagent is live in them; 0 keeps every subagent on the main thread
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 子代理的最大工作线程数。最多 8 个并发子代理跑在主线程；第 9 个起加入一个 worker，数量每翻倍再增一个（18、36、72）。worker 中无存活子代理一分钟后停止；0 表示所有子代理都留在主线程

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Hard wall-clock limit per subagent (ms). 0 disables it. Defense-in-depth against provider-side stream hangs that escape the inference-layer watchdog; triggers a normal subagent abort with a 'timed out' reason.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 每个子代理的硬性墙钟上限（毫秒）。0 为禁用。纵深防御逃过推理层看门狗的服务商侧流式挂起；触发一次以 'timed out' 为原因的常规子代理中止。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Ask a working subagent, through a cached side request like /btw, to estimate how complete its task is: after 2, 5, 10 and 30 more minutes, then hourly. The estimate shows next to the subagent in wait and task views. Only subagents spawned by the main agent of an interactive session are asked; print, RPC, ACP and SDK runs never probe.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 通过 /btw 式缓存旁路请求让工作中的子代理估计任务完成度：分别在 2、5、10、30 分钟后，之后每小时一次。估计值显示在等待与任务视图的子代理旁。仅询问交互会话主代理派生的子代理；print、RPC、ACP、SDK 运行从不探测。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: How long an idle subagent stays live in memory before being parked to disk (ms). Parked agents are revived automatically when messaged or resumed. 0 keeps idle agents live until exit.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 空闲子代理在内存中存活多久后落盘挂起（毫秒）。被挂起的代理在收到消息或恢复时自动复活。0 表示空闲代理一直存活到退出。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Soft per-subagent request budget (assistant requests per run). Crossing it injects a wrap-up steering notice (see task.softRequestBudgetNotice); at 1.5x the budget the run is force-stopped and the agent must hand back its partial findings. 0 disables the guard. Bundled scout/sonic agents cap out at a lower built-in budget, so a value below that cap still applies to them. A task.agentSoftRequestBudget entry replaces this budget for the agent it names.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 每个子代理的软性请求预算（每轮助手请求数）。越过即注入收尾引导提示（见 task.softRequestBudgetNotice）；达到预算 1.5 倍时强制停止并要求交还部分成果。0 关闭该防护。内置 scout/sonic 代理有更低的内置预算上限，低于该上限的值仍对它们生效。task.agentSoftRequestBudget 条目会为指定代理替换此预算。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Inject one steering notice when a subagent crosses its soft request budget, asking it to wrap up before the 1.5x forced-yield stop.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 子代理越过软性请求预算时注入一条引导提示，要求其在 1.5 倍强制让渡停止前收尾。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Maximum reasoning effort allowed for the task tool's per-spawn effort hint or a per-call model. An explicit `:level` is clamped to the highest supported effort at or below this ceiling, and an omitted `:level` inherits the agent's thinking level capped at this value; cold revival re-applies the cap. Unset, `:inherit` and `:off` keep their existing meaning. A per-call model must support an effort at or below this ceiling; the default preserves the model's full range.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: task 工具按派发 effort 提示或按调用模型所允许的最大推理强度。显式 `:level` 钳制到不超过此上限的最高支持强度；省略 `:level` 则继承代理思考级别并同样受上限约束；冷启动复活时重新应用上限。Unset、`:inherit`、`:off` 保持原义。按调用模型必须支持不超过该上限的强度；默认保留模型全部范围。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Arm prewalk for the bundled generic `task` subagent: it starts on its resolved model, plans and begins the implementation, then hands off to the 'smol' role at its first edit/write. Per-agent overrides (task.agentPrewalk, configured from the /agents hub) and user agent `prewalk` frontmatter apply regardless of this toggle.
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 为内置通用 `task` 子代理启动预遍历：它在解析出的模型上启动、规划并开始实现，首次编辑/写入时移交 'smol' 角色。按代理覆盖项（task.agentPrewalk，在 /agents 中心配置）与用户代理的 `prewalk` frontmatter 无论此开关均生效。

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Allow per-task isolation with `isolated: true`; tasks without it run in the shared checkout
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 允许以 `isolated: true` 做任务级隔离；未标注的任务在共享工作副本中运行

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Backend used for subagent isolation and worktree cloning
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 用于子代理隔离与 worktree 克隆的后端
macOS clonefile 写时复制链接（APFS）
Linux FICLONE 按文件写时复制链接
Linux 内核 overlay（或 fuse-overlayfs 回退）
Windows Projected File System（投影文件系统）

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: git worktree if available, otherwise recursive copy
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 可用时用 git worktree，否则递归复制

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Whether fresh interactive sessions start in a new linked worktree
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 新交互会话是否在一个新的关联 worktree 中开始

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Always start in a new worktree on a `wt/*` branch
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 总是在 `wt/*` 分支上的新 worktree 中开始

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: What to do on exit with worktrees created since omp started (on start or with `/wt`)
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 退出时如何处理自 omp 启动以来（启动时或经 `/wt`）创建的 worktree

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Remove clean worktrees; ask when they have uncommitted changes or new commits. Gitignored files (e.g. `.env`) are deleted too
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 移除干净的 worktree；有未提交改动或新提交时询问。被 .gitignore 的文件（如 `.env`）同样删除

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Automatically apply successful isolated task changes to the parent checkout; disable to retain patch or branch artifacts
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 自动把成功的隔离任务改动应用到父工作副本；关闭则以 patch 或分支形式保留产物

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: How isolated task changes are integrated (patch apply or branch merge)
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 隔离任务改动的合入方式（patch 应用或分支合并）
合并 diff 后用 git apply
由 AI 根据 diff 生成提交信息

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: How strongly to push the main agent to delegate work; subagents keep the model's own policy
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 推动主代理委派工作的力度；子代理仍遵循模型自身策略

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Uses the selected model's policy; some models require an explicit delegation request
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 使用所选模型的策略；部分模型需要显式委派请求

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Adds delegation guidance to the system prompt
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 向系统提示词加入委派指引

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Prompt guidance plus a first-turn delegation reminder
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 提示词指引加首轮委派提醒

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Judge each prompt and report the split without acting on it
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 判定每条提示词并报告拆分结果但不执行

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: When a prompt splits into independent subtasks, tell the agent to delegate them in parallel
packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..zh: 当提示词拆出独立子任务时，让代理并行委派

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: Expose the optional effort parameter on task spawns, allowing callers to override each subagent's thinking level

packages/coding-agent/src/task/settings..en: ovnfs executable; unset looks for `ovnfs` on PATH. When it is found, ovnfs checkouts (copy-on-write views of a folder, ready in about a second at any size) serve every separate copy: the system prompt tells agents to open checkouts instead of git worktrees or copies, and with `isolation.backend` on auto, isolated subagents (when allowed) run in checkouts instead of native clones and `/wt` moves the session into a checkout instead of a linked worktree

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/browser/.en: Drive your own Chrome tabs through the omp browser relay. Install the extension once (`omp browser-relay install`); its native host serves the relay while Chrome runs. Takes precedence over Browser CDP URL; set PI_BROWSER_RELAY=0 or PI_BROWSER_RELAY=1 to override, or PI_BROWSER_RELAY=only to make it the only browser (sessions started from the extension's side panel). Subagents skip it unless an open passes app: "relay" or the relay is the only browser.

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Maximum size of the artifact file saved for streaming tool output (bash, python, js eval). Larger output keeps its beginning (up to 3 MB) and its most recent remainder, with a truncation notice between them. 0 = unlimited.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 为流式工具输出（bash、python、js eval）保存的附件文件大小上限。更大的输出保留开头（最多 3 MB）与最近的剩余部分，中间以截断提示分隔。0 = 不限制。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Hard ceiling on summary size while BFS-unfolding. An unfold whose revealed lines would exceed this is skipped (that span stays folded) and unfolding continues with the remaining spans.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 广度优先展开时摘要大小的硬性上限。展开后行数将超过此值的代码段会被跳过（保持折叠），继续展开其余代码段。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Per-tool approval policies. Set to 'allow' to auto-approve, 'prompt' to require confirmation, or 'deny' to block. Overrides are honored in every approval mode.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 各工具的审批策略。设为 'allow' 自动批准，'prompt' 需要确认，'deny' 阻止。覆盖项在所有审批模式下生效。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Default approval behavior for tool calls. 'Always ask' auto-approves read-only tools only. 'Ask and remember' also asks before file reads, and can remember a file or folder. 'Write' auto-approves read and workspace-write tools. 'Yolo' auto-approves all tiers; user policy may still prompt or block.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 工具调用的默认审批行为。“总是询问”仅自动批准只读工具。“询问并记住”读文件前也会询问，并可记住文件或文件夹。“Write”自动批准读与工作区写工具。“Yolo”自动批准所有层级；用户策略仍可要求确认或阻止。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Ask before reading or writing a file, with answers that remember the file or its folder for this session or every session; require confirmation for exec tools.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 读写文件前先询问，回答可记住该文件或其所在文件夹——仅本会话或所有会话；执行类工具需要确认。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Folders where every read, write, edit, search, or command needs an explicit approval, whatever the approval mode or a remembered grant. The folder and everything under it is restricted; commands are matched by the directory they run in. A JSON list of paths, e.g. ["~/secrets"].
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 其中的每个读、写、编辑、搜索或命令都需要显式批准的文件夹，无论审批模式或已记住的授权如何。该文件夹及其全部内容都受限；命令按运行目录匹配。取值为 JSON 路径列表，如 ["~/secrets"]。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Model selector (e.g. openrouter/liquid/d1-ultra) tried first for find's passage verification, before the judge role; filename and sketch ranking stay on the judge role. Unset: the judge role verifies too
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 用于 find 段落验证优先尝试的模型选择器（如 openrouter/liquid/d1-ultra），先于 judge 角色；文件名与草图排序仍归 judge 角色。不设置时由 judge 角色一并验证。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Per-request timeout for the vision-model call behind read's ?q= image questions, in milliseconds. A stalled provider fails fast with a timeout error instead of blocking until manual abort. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: read 的 ?q= 图像提问背后视觉模型调用的单请求超时（毫秒）。服务商卡住时以超时错误快速失败，而不是阻塞到手动中止。设为 0 禁用超时。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the github tool (op-based dispatch for repository, issue, pull request, diff, search, checkout, push, and Actions watch workflows)
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 github 工具（基于 op 分发仓库、issue、PR、diff、搜索、checkout、push 与 Actions watch 工作流）

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Past the soft TTL the cached row is returned and refreshed in the background; past the hard TTL it is dropped (seconds; default 7 days)
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 超过软时效仍返回缓存行并在后台刷新；超过硬时效则丢弃（秒；默认 7 天）

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the discard-safe first slice: validated local reads through direct read calls and nested eval. Network requests, provider completions, and live filesystem writes are not part of this baseline.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用可安全丢弃的首个分片：通过直接 read 调用与嵌套 eval 做已验证的本地读取。网络请求、服务商补全与真实文件写入不在此基线内。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: In print mode (-p, --mode json), keep running after the last prompt while this run's background jobs are active, and start another turn in the same session with each job's result; exits once no job or result is pending. Off: print mode exits after its prompts and cancels running jobs
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 在打印模式（-p、--mode json）下，最后一条提示词结束后若本次运行的后台任务仍活跃则继续运行，并用每个任务的结果在同一会话再启一轮；无待处理任务或结果时退出。关闭时：打印模式在提示词结束后退出并取消运行中的任务

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Draw a live widget for each running background job (charts, bars, status grids derived from its output) in the wait card, the jobs pill and the jobs sheet, and caption long shell commands with one line on what they do. The `widget` model role (default: `smol`) writes one spec and at most one caption per job; updates need no further model calls
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 在等待卡片、任务胶囊与任务面板中为每个运行中的后台任务绘制实时小组件（由其输出派生的图表、进度条、状态格），并为较长的 shell 命令加一行用途说明。`widget` 模型角色（默认 `smol`）为每个任务写一份规格、至多一条说明；更新无需再调模型

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Tool output above this size is saved as an artifact; tail is kept inline
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 超过此大小的工具输出会保存为附件；末尾部分保留在会话内

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Amount of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 输出溢出到附件时，保留在会话内的末尾内容量

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Maximum lines of tail content kept inline when output spills to artifact
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 输出溢出到附件时，保留在会话内的最大末尾行数

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Prepend line numbers to read tool output by default
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 默认在 read 工具输出前加行号

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Default number of lines returned when agent calls read without a limit
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 智能体调用 read 未指定行数上限时默认返回的行数

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Render Markdown read results as formatted terminal Markdown previews instead of raw source
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 将 Markdown 读取结果渲染为终端排版预览，而非原始源码

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Return structural code summaries when read is called without an explicit selector
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 未显式指定选择器调用 read 时返回结构化代码摘要

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Return structural summaries for Markdown and plain text reads
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 对 Markdown 与纯文本读取返回结构化摘要

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Minimum multiline body or literal length before read summaries collapse it
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 多行函数体或字面量超过此行数才会在 read 摘要中被折叠

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Minimum multiline block comment length before read summaries collapse it
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 多行块注释超过此行数才会在 read 摘要中被折叠

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Files with fewer total lines are read verbatim instead of structurally summarized
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 总行数少于该值的文件逐字读取，不做结构化摘要

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: BFS-unfold elidable spans until the summary is at least this many visible lines. 0 keeps only the outermost elisions.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 广度优先展开可省略的代码段，直到摘要至少达到此可见行数。0 表示仅保留最外层省略。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Render read tool results inline in the transcript instead of summary rows
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 在对话记录中内联渲染 read 工具结果，而非显示摘要行

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Auto-approve read-only tools; require confirmation for write and exec tools.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 自动批准只读工具；写与执行类工具需要确认。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Auto-approve read-only and write tools; require confirmation for exec tools such as bash, eval, browser, and task.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 自动批准只读与写工具；bash、eval、browser、task 等执行类工具需要确认。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Auto-approve read, write, and exec tools. User policy can still require confirmation or block calls.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 自动批准读、写与执行类工具。用户策略仍可要求确认或阻止调用。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: tools.restrictedFolders must be a list of folder paths
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: tools.restrictedFolders 必须是文件夹路径列表

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the todo tool for task tracking
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 todo 工具进行任务跟踪

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Remind the agent to complete todos before stopping
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 提醒智能体在停止前完成 todo 项

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Maximum number of todo reminders before giving up
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 放弃前的最大 todo 提醒次数

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: How strongly to push automatic todo-list creation after the first message
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 首条消息后自动创建 todo 列表的推动强度

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Model decides; no automatic todo list
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 由模型决定；不自动创建 todo 列表

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Suggests a todo list on the first message (reminder, not forced)
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 在首条消息建议创建 todo 列表（提醒，不强制）

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Forces a comprehensive todo list on the first message
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 在首条消息强制创建完整的 todo 列表

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Delay before completed or abandoned todos are removed from the todo widget
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 已完成或已放弃的 todo 项从 todo 小组件移除前的延迟

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the glob tool for glob-based file lookup
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 glob 工具，按通配模式查找文件

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the grep tool for regex content search
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 grep 工具，按正则搜索内容

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Lines of context before each grep match
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 每个 grep 匹配项之前的上下文行数

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Lines of context after each grep match
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 每个 grep 匹配项之后的上下文行数

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the ast_grep tool for structural AST search
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 ast_grep 工具进行结构化 AST 搜索

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the ast_edit tool for structural AST rewrites
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 ast_edit 工具进行结构化 AST 改写

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Always enable, whichever model the judge role resolves to
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 无论 judge 角色解析为何种模型都启用

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the debug tool for DAP-based debugging
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 debug 工具进行基于 DAP 的调试

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the scriptable host-desktop eval prelude (screenshots, input, accessibility)
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用可脚本化的宿主机桌面 eval 前导（截图、输入、无障碍）

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the ratchet eval/hillclimb prelude; /ratchet turns it on for the current session
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 ratchet eval/爬坡前导；/ratchet 可为当前会话开启

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the read-only archive eval prelude: prompt history, recent projects, past sessions and recaps
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用只读归档 eval 前导：提示词历史、最近项目、过往会话与回顾

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Active window's display (active), all displays (all), or a native display id
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 活动窗口所在显示器（active）、全部显示器（all），或原生显示器 id
Image Question Timeout（图像提问超时）

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the checkpoint and rewind tools for context checkpointing
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 checkpoint 与 rewind 工具进行上下文检查点

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Allow the read tool to fetch and process URLs
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 允许 read 工具抓取并处理 URL

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Cache rendered issue/PR view output in ~/.omp/cache/github-cache.db so repeated reads are free
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 把渲染后的 issue/PR 视图输出缓存到 ~/.omp/cache/github-cache.db，重复读取零开销
GitHub Cache Soft TTL（缓存软时效）

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Within this window, cached issue/PR view rows are returned directly (seconds; default 5 minutes)
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 在此时间窗内直接返回缓存的 issue/PR 视图行（秒；默认 5 分钟）

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the web_search tool for live web results
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 web_search 工具获取实时网络结果

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the ask tool for interactive user questions
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 ask 工具进行交互式用户提问

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Maximum number of validated local reads allowed to run before normal dispatch.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 正常分发前允许运行的已验证本地读取最大次数。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Maximum timeout in seconds the agent can set for any tool (0 = no limit)
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 智能体可为任一工具设置的最大超时秒数（0 = 不限制）

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable async bash commands and background task execution
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用异步 bash 命令与后台任务执行

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: How often a long turn is reminded to update its todo list while it keeps changing things
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 长轮次持续改动时，多久提醒一次更新 todo 列表

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Nudge after 12 edits or commands, at most twice until the todo list changes or you send a message
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 每 12 次编辑或命令提醒一次，直到 todo 列表变化或你发消息，最多两次

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Keep nudging with a doubling gap: after 12, 24, 48, 96, then every 192 edits or commands
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 间隔翻倍地持续提醒：12、24、48、96 次后，每 192 次编辑或命令提醒

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the commit eval prelude and /commit: commit only the lines this agent and its subagents wrote
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 commit eval prelude 和 /commit：只提交本智能体及其子智能体写的行

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Invalid find.hitThreshold: expected a number above 0, up to 1, got ${}.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 无效 find.hitThreshold：应为大于 0、至多 1 的数字，得到 ${}。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the tts tool for on-device (Phonon) or xAI Grok Voice speech-file synthesis
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 tts 工具进行设备端（Phonon）或 xAI Grok Voice 语音文件合成

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Choose which mounted commands get their `--help` text inlined in the system prompt. Built-ins keeps core tools inline while MCP and extension tools stay on demand.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 选择把哪些已挂载命令的 `--help` 文本内联进系统提示词。Built-ins 让核心工具内联，MCP 与扩展工具按需获取。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the find tool: natural-language search for files and line ranges, judged by the judge model role. Auto enables it when the first usable judge is native
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 find 工具：按自然语言搜索文件与行范围，由 judge 模型角色判定。仅当首个可用 judge 为原生模型时自动启用

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Inline built-in help; MCP and extension help on demand.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 内联内置帮助；MCP 与扩展帮助按需获取。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Inline help for every mounted command.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 内联每个已挂载命令的帮助。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Ask the agent to describe the intent of each tool call before executing it. Unset: on in the interactive TUI, off in print, RPC, ACP, and SDK sessions
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 要求代理在执行每个工具调用前说明其意图。未设置时：交互 TUI 开，print、RPC、ACP 与 SDK 会话关

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: With in-band tool calls, stop the model immediately when it starts hallucinating a tool result mid-turn. Disable to let the model finish generating and discard the fabricated continuation instead.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 使用带内工具调用时，模型一旦在轮次中开始臆造工具结果立即停止。禁用则让模型完成生成并丢弃臆造的后续内容。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: List every command; run `--help` on demand.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 列出所有命令；按需运行 `--help`。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Mount rarely-used (discoverable) tools as bash commands with schema-derived `--help` instead of shipping their schemas on every request. Needs the bash tool: sessions without it keep every enabled tool top-level. Disable to expose every enabled tool top-level.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 把低频（可发现）工具以 bash 命令形式挂载，用 schema 派生的 `--help` 代替在每次请求中都携带其 schema。需要 bash 工具：没有它的会话会把所有启用工具保持为顶层。禁用则把所有启用工具暴露为顶层。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable the generate_image tool (text-to-image generation and editing). Mounted as a tool command when tools.commands is on.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 启用 generate_image 工具（文生图与图片编辑）。tools.commands 开启时挂载为工具命令。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Automated tool issue reporting (`report_issue`). On by default; the first report asks for consent, and denying it disables reporting until re-enabled explicitly
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 自动工具问题上报（`report_issue`）。默认开启；首次上报会征求同意，拒绝后在上报被显式重新启用前一直关闭

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Show a notice when MCP or extension tools are mounted or unmounted as commands; the model still learns of the change with its next prompt.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 当 MCP 或扩展工具被挂载/卸载为命令时显示通知；模型会在下一次提示中得知变更。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: When Tool Command Prompt Docs is Built-ins Only, also inline dynamic commands whose names match these glob patterns (for example mcp__context_mode_*). Catalog Only ignores this setting.
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 当“工具命令提示词文档”为“仅内置”时，也把名字匹配这些 glob 的动态命令内联（例如 mcp__context_mode_*）。“仅目录”忽略此设置。

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Enable when the first usable judge is native
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 首个可用 judge 为原生模型时启用

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Extension that the todo list is mirrored to; Native keeps it in the session only
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 待办列表镜像到哪个扩展；Native 表示只保留在会话内

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: When window input takes over (the real pointer and keyboard; your Escape stops it) instead of running in the background
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 窗口输入何时接管（真实指针与键盘；按 Escape 可停止）而不是在后台运行

packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.en: Background first; a call whose background route is unavailable briefly brings the target forward, then returns focus to your app (on macOS even if you kept typing). The agent may also ask for takeover on a call
packages/coding-agent/src/tools/settings.zh: 后台优先；后台路由不可用的调用会短暂把目标提到前面，随后把焦点还给你的应用（在 macOS 上即使你仍在打字）。代理也可以对单个调用请求接管

序列化工具调用参数的字符数

Which models call which tools, and how often those calls fail

packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.zh: 范围内每分桶的调用数

packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.en: Calls whose result came back flagged as an error
packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.zh: 结果被标记为错误的调用
每调用平均工具结果字符数

packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.en: No tool calls in this range
packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.zh: 此范围内没有工具调用

packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.en: Tool results that came back flagged as errors
packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.zh: 返回时被标记为错误的工具结果

packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.en: Tokens and API-equivalent cost of each invoking turn, split evenly across that turn's tool calls
packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.zh: 每个发起回合的词元数与 API 等效费用，均摊到该回合的各次工具调用

packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.en: ${}. Select a tool to break it down by model.
No calls to ${} in this range
packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.zh: 此范围内没有对 ${} 的调用

packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.en: Which tools omp called in ${}, how often they failed, and what they cost.
packages/stats/src/client/routes/ToolsRo.zh: omp 在 ${} 内调用的工具、失败频率与花费。

packages/stats/src/client/routes/TracesR.en: Recent sessions with subagent activity folded in. Open one to inspect its timeline.
packages/stats/src/client/routes/TracesR.zh: 最近会话，已合并子代理活动。打开一个查看其时间线。

packages/stats/src/client/routes/TracesR.en: Run a sync to index recent activity.
packages/stats/src/client/routes/TracesR.zh: 运行一次 sync 以索引最近活动。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Comp.en: A cut is never re-read: each later request of the session carries a smaller context
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Comp.zh: 裁掉的内容永不再读：会话每个后续请求都带更小的上下文

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Comp.en: Context = input + cache read + cache write of each request. A compaction is a request whose context is under 60% of the previous one's; it ends the carry.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Comp.zh: 上下文 = 每个请求的输入 + 缓存读 + 缓存写。compaction 是上下文小于前一个 60% 的请求，它会终止延续。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Comp.en: No experiment sessions in this range
This session has no recorded requests.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Comp.zh: 此会话没有记录的请求。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Comp.en: No requests recorded for this session
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Comp.zh: 此会话没有记录的请求

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Comp.en: of what its requests would have carried without Spotlight: ${} prompt tokens, net of recoveries.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Comp.zh: ，相对没有 Spotlight 时其请求本会携带的：${} 个 prompt 词元，已扣除取回。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Cove.en: Share of the tool output experiment sessions' models saw, by tool: the unshaped ones are where shaping could reach next
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Cove.zh: 实验会话中模型看到的工具输出占比，按工具：未 shape 的是 shaping 下一步可到达的

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Cove.en: Tokens are tool-result chars ÷ 4 over the experiment's sessions in the range; a tool counts as shaped when the experiment evaluated any of its results in the range.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Cove.zh: 词元 = 范围内实验会话的工具结果字符 ÷ 4；实验在范围内评估过任一结果的工具计为已 shape。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Econ.en: Net dollars per 100 cuts after fetch-backs, extra turns and Spotlight's own bill
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Econ.zh: 每 100 次裁剪的净美元，已扣除 fetch-back、额外轮次和 Spotlight 自身开销

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Econ.en: Shortened results only; held-out ones save nothing. Every fetch-back counts against the cut here, the share held-out results show comes back anyway included, so this is the cautious view. An extra turn is a request whose every tool call fetched back output these cuts hid. Dollars price saved and fetched-back tokens as carried context, like Compounding.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Econ.zh: 仅缩短的结果；hold-out 的不省。此处置每次 fetch-back 都计入裁剪——包括 hold-out 结果显示仍会回来的那部分——所以这是保守口径。额外轮次指其每个工具调用都取回了这些裁剪藏起输出的请求。美元按携带上下文给节省和取回词元计价，同 Compounding。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Fetc.en: One rule for every group: within 12 calls, a read of the same path overlapping the result's own window (the whole file without a selector), a rerun of the call (a similar bash command; for other tools, ≥ 60% shared argument tokens), or a read of an artifact it named; not after an edit of that path (reads) or any edit (reruns), nor from the same request.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Fetc.zh: 每组适用同一规则：在 12 次调用内，读取同一路径且与结果自身窗口重叠（无 selector 的整文件）、重跑该调用（相似的 bash 命令；其他工具为共享参数词元 ≥ 60%）、或读取它指名的 artifact；但在该路径被编辑之后（读取）或任何编辑之后（重跑）不算，同一次请求内也不算。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Fetc.en: Does the agent come back for it?
Share of results the agent fetched more of within 12 calls: cut with Spotlight's scores, cut without them, held out at random, kept whole by pi's former edit gate, and left unchanged
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Fetc.zh: 代理在 12 次调用内取回更多内容的结果占比：带 Spotlight 评分裁剪的、无评分裁剪的、随机 hold-out 的、被 pi 旧编辑门完整保留的、以及未改动的

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Fetc.en: Calls between a result and the first fetch-back after it
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Fetc.zh: 结果与其后首次 fetch-back 之间的调用数

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Fetc.en: Bars are each group's share of its own fetch-backs, so shortened and held-out results compare despite their different counts (next to each tool). Same rule as above; nothing after 12 calls counts.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Fetc.zh: 柱是每组占自身 fetch-back 的份额，所以缩短和 hold-out 结果在计数不同的情况下仍可比（在每个工具旁）。规则同上；12 次调用之后的不计。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Fetc.en: ${} Held-out results are the true counterfactual: drawn at random from the would-be cuts and shown whole; until they accumulate, unchanged results stand in, re-weighted to the cuts' size mix. Score-free cuts skip Spotlight by a second coin and take the no-score fallback rules: if they come back as often as scored cuts, the scores add nothing. Gated reads are reads pi's former edit gate (removed) kept whole, listed only where the range has any. Small print: score-free · held out · unchanged. Whiskers are 90% session bootstrap intervals, from 3 sessions.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Fetc.zh: ${} 留出结果是真正的反事实：从候选裁切中随机抽取并完整展示；在其积累足够前，由未变更结果按裁切大小配比加权替代。无分裁切由二次抛币跳过 Spotlight，采用无分回退规则：若其召回率与有分裁切相同，则分数没有贡献。门控读取是 pi 旧编辑门（已移除）保留完整的读取，仅在范围含有时列出。小字：无分 · 留出 · 未变更。须线为 90% 会话自助置信区间，来自 3 个会话。
${} ${} 后：${} 次 fetch-back（共 ${} 个 ${}）

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.en: Cuts a random coin made without Spotlight (the no-score fallback rules): what Spotlight's scores add is the difference
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.zh: 随机硬币不用 Spotlight 做的裁剪（无评分回退规则）：Spotlight 评分带来的正是差值
不用 Spotlight 裁剪，作对照

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.en: Avoided context priced at each later request's cache rates, minus the fetch-backs beyond the holdout baseline (priced the same way) and Spotlight's own bill
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.zh: 按后续请求缓存费率计价的 avoided context，减去超出留出基线的回取量（同口径计价）和 Spotlight 自身开销

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.en: ${} older ${} plain from the inline cap.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.zh: ${} 更早的 ${} 平铺自行内上限。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.en: Σ (plain − shortened) tokens over shortened results; a cut that showed more than plain counts negative
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.zh: 被裁短结果上的 Σ（平铺 − 裁短）词元；展示多于平铺的裁剪计为负

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.en: Would-be cuts shown whole at random: the baseline per tool (under ${} is thin)
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.zh: 随机完整展示的潜在裁剪：逐工具基线（${} 以下偏薄）

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.en: ${} of tool output · ${} of ${} results shortened
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.zh: ${} 工具输出 · ${}/${} 个结果被缩短

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.en: ${} ${} wider than plain would have shown: cuts shown that way count as losses, results pi capped at plain's text save nothing.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.zh: ${} ${} 比平铺展示更宽：这样展示的裁剪计为损失，pi 截断到平铺文本的结果不省任何东西。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.en: Fetch-back tokens beyond what held-out results (shown whole) fetch anyway, per tool and whether plain capped the result; 90% interval below
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Hero.zh: 超出保底结果（完整显示）无论如何都会取回量的回取词元，按工具与 plain 是否截断该结果分；90% 区间见下

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.en: Results whose Spotlight calls failed or timed out, of those that called it: they were cut by the no-score fallback
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.zh: 调用了 Spotlight 的结果中其调用失败或超时的：它们被无评分回退裁剪

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.en: Why the calls failed, as shares of the results that called Spotlight. A result whose calls failed two ways counts under both; unrecorded results were journaled before pi recorded causes
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.zh: 调用失败原因，占调用 Spotlight 结果的比例。两种方式都失败的结果两项都计；未记录的结果是在 pi 记录原因之前入库的

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.en: Wall time tool calls spent on Spotlight calls that failed or timed out
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.zh: 工具调用花在失败或超时 Spotlight 调用上的墙钟时间

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.en: Results Spotlight evaluated, held-out ones included
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.zh: Spotlight 评估的结果，含 hold-out

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.en: Wall time shaping added to a tool call
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.zh: shaping 给工具调用增加的墙钟时间

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.en: Spotlight's own request time, over results whose calls all answered
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.zh: Spotlight 自身请求耗时，仅统计调用全部应答的结果

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.en: What shaping costs: Spotlight failures, added latency and its bill
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.zh: shaping 的开销：Spotlight 失败、增加的延迟及其账单

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.en: Every evaluated result counts, held-out ones included: they were shaped too, just not shown.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Over.zh: 每个已评估结果都计入，含 hold-out：它们也被 shape 了，只是没展示。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.zh: 热度把需要的行排得更高
最热十分之一包含它们

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.en: Does Spotlight keep what the agent needs?
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.zh: Spotlight 保住了代理需要的吗？

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.en: Lines of a shaped read the agent read again or edited later, against Spotlight's heat and the cut
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.zh: 代理后来重读或编辑过的 shaped 读取中的行，对照 Spotlight 热度与裁剪

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.en: Shaped reads with at least one needed line, until the file's first edit or a later whole-file read. Scored and score-free cuts are biased alike (the agent re-reads what a cut hid), so compare them with each other; held-out would-be cuts, shown whole, are the unbiased measure. Score-free cuts have no heat, so only the cut's lift exists for them. Dashed lines are chance; whiskers are 90% session bootstrap intervals, from 3 sessions.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.zh: 至少含一行被需要的 shaped 读取，截至文件首次编辑或之后整文件读取。带评分与无评分裁剪同样偏置（代理重读被裁剪藏起的内容），所以互相比较；hold-out 的本应裁剪（完整展示）是无偏度量。无评分裁剪没有热度，所以只有裁剪本身的提升存在。虚线是随机水平；须线是 90% 会话 bootstrap 区间，来自 3 个会话。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.en: P(a needed line is hotter than an unneeded line of the same result), ties half
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.zh: P（同一结果中所需行比非所需行更热），平局各半

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.en: Needed-line rate among each result's hottest 10% of lines over its rate among all lines
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.zh: 每个结果最热 10% 行中的所需行占比 ÷ 全部行中的占比

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.en: Share of needed lines the cut kept over the share of all lines it kept
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.zh: 截断保留的所需行占比 ÷ 保留的全部行占比

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.en: A later read of the same file selected the lines
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.zh: 同一文件的后续读取选中了这些行

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.en: A later edit's Find text matched the lines
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Rank.zh: 后续编辑的 Find 文本匹配了这些行

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.en: What pi would have shown unshaped (plain) for the call, and what the cut showed; the bar is the share that survived
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.zh: pi 未 shape 本会显示的（plain）与裁剪后显示的；柱是存活比例

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.en: Held out: what the cut would have saved
Saved tokens minus the tokens of the calls that fetched hidden output back
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.zh: 节省词元减去取回隐藏输出的调用词元

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.en: Held out: the model saw the whole result, so nothing was saved
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.zh: Hold-out：模型看到了完整结果，所以没省

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.en: Held out at random: the model saw the original, unshortened result
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.zh: 随机 hold-out：模型看到了原始未缩短的结果

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.en: A random coin skipped Spotlight: the no-score fallback rules made this cut
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.zh: 随机硬币跳过了 Spotlight：无评分回退规则做了这次裁剪

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.en: The newest shortened and held-out tool results and what the agent fetched back
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.zh: 最新的缩短与 hold-out 工具结果及代理取回的内容

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.en: Saved is what plain would have shown minus what the cut showed (the would-be cut for held-out ones, which save nothing); recovery tokens are the recovery calls' results (chars ÷ 4 when no exact count exists).
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.zh: 已省 = plain 本会显示的减去裁剪后显示的（hold-out 用本应裁剪，不省）；取回词元是取回调用的结果（无精确计数时按字符 ÷ 4）。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.en: Held out: the model saw the whole result
Held out: the model saw the original
Fetched more although it saw everything
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.zh: 尽管看到了全部仍取回更多

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.en: Nothing fetched back: the full saving stands
plain would show ${} tokens, the cut ${} ${} (shaping read ${})
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Resu.zh: plain 会显示 ${} 词元，裁剪后 ${} ${}（shaping 读取 ${}）

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: 扣除每次取回后的净值（累计）

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.en: Dollars price each saved token at the cache-read rate of every later request that would have carried it (plus one cache write); recoveries are priced the same way.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: 美元按每个本会携带节省词元的后续请求的缓存读价格（加一次缓存写）计价；取回同法计价。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.en: Gross is what the cuts removed against what plain would have shown; this net subtracts every later call that fetched hidden output back, including the share held-out results show comes back anyway (the headline adds that back). Each lands in the bucket of its own timestamp.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: 毛值是裁剪相对 plain 本会显示的裁掉量；此净值减去每个后来取回隐藏输出的调用，包括 hold-out 结果显示仍会回来的份额（标题数字把它加回）。各自落在自身时间戳的分桶里。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.en: No shortened results in this range
Avoided context priced at each later request's cache-read rate, plus one cache write
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: 避免的上下文按每个后续请求的缓存读价格计价，加一次缓存写

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.en: Σ (plain − shortened) tokens over shortened results; a cut that showed more than plain counts negative
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: Σ（plain − 缩短）词元，对缩短结果求和；比 plain 展示更多的裁剪计负

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.en: Provider cost of requests that issued nothing but recovery calls
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: 只发出取回调用的请求的服务商开销

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.en: Gross, minus each way hidden output came back
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: 毛节省，减去隐藏输出回流的各种途径
${} 处裁剪回取了 ${} 词元

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.en: Running gross and net per ${}; what recoveries took back hangs below zero
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: 每${}的累计毛值与净值；取回拿走部分挂在零以下

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.en: Fetch-backs that are not the cuts' cost: what held-out results (shown whole) show the agent makes regardless, per tool and whether plain capped the result, plus fetch-backs of results shaping left whole
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: 不属于剪切成本的回取：保底结果（完整显示）显示代理无论如何都会产生的回取，按工具与 plain 是否截断该结果分，再加上整体保留结果的回取

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.en: Recoveries are priced as carried context; extra turns are requests that only recovered; Spotlight cost is its own scoring bill. What comes back anyway is the cuts' recovery $ in proportion to the tokens held-out results fetch regardless, plus the recovery $ of results shaping left whole.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: 恢复量按携带上下文计价；额外轮次是只做了恢复的请求；Spotlight 成本是独立的计分账单。无论如何都会回来的，是按保底结果总会取回的词元占比计出的剪切恢复 $，加上整体保留结果的恢复 $。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.en: Recovered tokens are the full results of the recovery calls (estimated as chars ÷ 4 where no exact count exists). What comes back anyway is, per tool, the tokens a held-out result gets fetched back times the cuts, apart for results plain capped and shown whole, plus the recovered tokens of results shaping left whole; while a side with cuts has under ${} held-out results, all the tool's cuts take its pooled rate.
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: 恢复的词元是恢复调用的完整结果（无精确计数时按字符数 ÷ 4 估算）。无论如何都会回来的，按工具计，是单个保底结果被回取的词元乘以剪切数，不计 plain 截断且完整显示的结果，再加上整体保留结果的恢复词元；当一侧剪切数不足 ${} 个保底结果时，该工具的所有剪切按其合并比率计。

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.en: ${} held-out results get ${} each fetched back anyway, pooled (cuts are priced apart by whether plain capped them once each side with cuts has enough held out)
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Savi.zh: ${} 个保底结果无论如何都各被回取 ${}，合并计（一旦每侧剪切都有了足够保底，剪切按 plain 是否截断分开计价）

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Shar.en: No tool calls in this range

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Shar.zh: 上下文中工具输出占比

packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Shar.en: Since ${}, shaped sessions should carry less tool output
packages/stats/src/client/spotlight/Shar.zh: 自 ${} 起，塑形会话应携带更少工具输出
